jobs.title: Assistant Professor in High Frequency Switch-Mode Power Supplies
jobs.description:
The Digital and High-Frequency Electronics (DHFE) section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, based at the university campus in Odense, seeks outstanding individuals for full-time Assistant Professor positions in Power Electronics, focusing on power management for electronic and computing devices and systems. Successful applicants are expected to contribute to the development of academic programs and the research community. Applicants should have a PhD in Power Electronics or a closely related field. 

The DHFE section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

Applicants are expected to establish and maintain a research program in high-frequency power electronics and power management for computation, along with low-voltage electronic systems. The position emphasizes converter and power-management for computing platforms and resource-constrained applications, including battery-operated, energy-harvesting, mobile, autonomous, embedded, and sensor-based systems.

The section is a vital component of our Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Science, and Master of Science programs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering in Odense. Currently, the section focuses on three research fields: 1) Drones for Infrastructure Inspections and Interactions, 2) High-Frequency SMPS and power management for low-power electronic systems, and 3) Telecommunication Systems. The section has 15 academics, including professors, postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, and engineers, to support research, industrial collaboration, and educational activities, and is growing steadily.

The SDU campus in Odense contains six faculties and soon a large university hospital, creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich, surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community, and highly livable with a green-banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas.

 

Job Description

The position focuses on power management for resource-constrained autonomous, mobile, and embedded electronic systems. Relevant research areas include high-frequency power conversion, battery-operated systems, energy harvesting, power management architectures, embedded control, and analog/digital control of converters. The application domain spans from ultra-low-power electronics and sensors to mobile platforms, robotics, drones, IoT devices, and power management for embedded, compact, and high-performance computing systems.

The role strengthens DHFE’s research profile at the interface between power electronics, microelectronics, embedded systems, and intelligent electronic devices. It is expected to support shared research themes across SDU, including energy-efficient electronics, autonomous systems, battery-powered platforms, sensor networks, health technology, and miniaturized or distributed devices.

The successful candidate should work constructively both with colleagues within DHFE and also with colleagues from other research units, such as SDU Microelectronics, SDU Centre for Industrial Electronics, the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, Faculty of Health (specifically Health Tech), Mechanical Engineering, and other relevant environments, translating power electronics competence into system-level contributions for electronic devices and platforms.

 

Duties

As a faculty member, you will be responsible for developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate teaching in Electronic and Electrical Engineering, with particular attention to strengthening control and power electronics within the BSc portfolio. This includes supervising students at Bachelor and Master’s level, mentoring students, integrating with the student body, and participating in education and outreach activities. Research duties include establishing an externally funded research agenda, publishing in leading journals and conferences, supervising early-career researchers, and contributing to the development of DHFE’s research environment. The candidate is also expected to contribute to external collaboration and perform service at the section, department, university, and professional levels.

 

Qualifications Required

  • The applicant should hold a doctoral degree (PhD) in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a related subject area. 

  • Demonstrated potential for teaching undergraduate and graduate courses at the university level. 

  • The applicant must have relevant research expertise in areas related to efficient and high-frequency power converters, converter control, and power management for computing or embedded electronic systems.

  • The applicant must have teaching skills that align with the content and responsibilities of the position. This includes possessing both pedagogical and professional skills essential for carrying out the tasks associated with the role. 

  • A strong track record for research fundraising is required. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tim McRae (mcrae@sdu.dk)  or the Head of the Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

  • Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must be in English and include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing the research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, etc.

  • A research plan with a focus on the development of your research line and research team. 

  • List of funded projects. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • List of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted. 

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.) 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

  

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. The final start date will be agreed with the successful applicant.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Instrumentation Engineer – Project-Based Employment | Nevita | Nynäshamn
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Instrumentation Engineer looking for a hands-on role in a complex process industry environment? Nevita is currently looking for an Instrumentation Engineer for an initial three-month project assignment at our client's site in Nynäshamn, with good opportunities for extension.

Your role

As an Instrumentation Engineer, you will work closely with operations, maintenance, engineering and other technical disciplines at an established process plant. The role combines engineering activities with practical, site-based support and is well suited to someone who enjoys working close to the plant and solving technical challenges in an operational environment.

Your responsibilities may include:

    

Engineering and technical support within instrumentation and control.

    

Working with P&IDs and translating process requirements into instrumentation solutions.

    

Selection and specification of instruments, control valves and associated equipment.

    

Working with pressure, flow, level and temperature measurement.

    

Reviewing I/O, instrument loops, datasheets and technical documentation.

    

Supporting modifications, upgrades and troubleshooting of existing installations.

    

Ensuring instrumentation solutions comply with applicable standards and requirements, including ATEX.

    

Coordinating with process, electrical, automation, maintenance and other engineering disciplines.

    

Supporting commissioning, testing, I/O checks and FAT/SAT activities when required.

    

Providing technical support to site activities, contractors and suppliers.

Your profile

We believe you have:

    

A technical degree in Instrumentation, Automation, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

    

Previous experience working with instrumentation in the process, petrochemical, refinery, energy or similar heavy industry.

    

Good understanding of P&IDs and industrial process systems.

    

Practical experience with instrumentation, I/O, loops, control valves and process measurement.

    

Knowledge of ATEX and instrumentation in hazardous areas.

    

The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with operations and other engineering disciplines.

    

Good communication skills in English.

Experience with SIL/SIS and Functional Safety is considered an advantage. Experience with PLC/DCS systems, commissioning, FAT/SAT, troubleshooting or control systems such as ABB 800xA/AC800M, Emerson DeltaV or Siemens PCS7/TIA Portal is also beneficial.

About us

We are an engineering consultancy with an office in central Gothenburg and a growing presence in Stockholm. As industries transition towards a more sustainable future, we provide specialist engineering expertise to global and well-established clients within the gas, oil, chemical and energy sectors. Our projects often focus on the green transition, circular economy, CCS, hydrogen (H₂), HVO and LNG.

At Nevita, you will have the opportunity to work on large and exciting industrial projects, either on-site with our clients or in projects managed by Nevita. You will become part of a skilled and collaborative team where knowledge sharing and professional development are key values.

What we offer

    

Competitive employment terms and a flexible benefits package

    

Occupational pension, wellness allowance and dedicated time for wellness activities

    

Opportunities to work on large and technically challenging industrial projects

    

Continuous professional development and knowledge sharing

    

A social and inclusive culture where we care about each other and enjoy working together

Interested?

Submit your application today! Applications are reviewed and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact:

📧 oscar.sahlin@nevita.se

jobs.description:
Etsimme hydrauliikka-asentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Turkuun! Asiakasyrityksemme on erikoistunut laivateollisuuteen ja he tarjoavat kattavasti hydrauliikkahuolto- ja korjauspalveluita toimipisteellään, telakoilla ja aluksilla.

Pääasiallisena tehtävänäsi on toimia asentajana hydrauliikkaan liittyvissä huolto- ja korjaustehtävissä esim. letkujen valmistus sekä huolto. Tehtäviä voi olla aika ajoin myös sylinterityöt, öljyjen vaihto tai vaativammatkin korjaustyöt. Töitä tehdään kokoaikaisesti 37,5h/viikko ja odotamme hakijalta reissuvalmiutta, sillä töitä tehdään asiakasyrityksen toimipisteellä, telakoilla ja aluksilla. Reissujen pituudet vaihtelevat aina muutamasta päivästä pariin viikkoon riippuen telakasta/aluksesta ja tämän sijainnista, mutta useimmiten nämä sijaitsevat Suomessa tai muualla Euroopassa. Ajoittaisen ulkomaanreissaamisen vuoksi edellytämme sinulta vähintään kohtalaista englannin kielen osaamista.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- Aikaisempi tehtävään soveltuva koulutus esim. raskaan kaluston koulutus, hydrauliikka ja/tai työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä on eduksi tehtävässä menestymisen kannalta.

\- Oman ajoneuvon käyttömahdollisuutta asiakasyrityksen sijainnin vuoksi ja lisäksi C-ajokortti lasketaan eduksi.

\- Reissuvalmiutta aina muutamasta päivästä muutamaan viikkoon asti ajoittain.

\- Arvostamme myös kiinnostusta tekniikkaa ja koneita kohtaan, kyvykkyyttä sitoutua tehtävään, halua oppia ja omaksua uusia asioita, kykyä omatoimiseen ja tiimityöskentelyyn, joustavuutta sekä rehtiä ja reipasta työskentelyotetta.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Täytä hakemuksesi ohessa olevan linkin kautta ja kerro siinä mahdollisimman kattavasti itsestäsi, osaamisestasi sekä aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. jobs.title: Customs Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Hej Customs Operations Specialist,

Do you want to go to work and help create a better life at home?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Customs Operations Specialist, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

As a Customs Operations Specialist, you’ll play an important part in the team and contribute to a better everyday life for the many. Your primary focus will be to send correctly compiled import declarations using a digital solution in direct contact with Customs Authorities in each country. The impact of our work will resonate in homes and hearts across the world. On a typical working day, you will:

    Control and investigate various issues to secure compliance in securing every customs declaration according to countries legislations.  

    Secure good communication and support to and from other IKEA units, external service providers and authorities within Europe to ensure timely, accurate and compliant entries according to customs rules and regulations.

    Contribute to the development of how we work and reach our goals within the department.  

What we’d like you to bring to the table

To be successful in the role as a Customs Operations Specialist we believe you are:

    Experienced in or hold an education within the field of customs and import operation, logistics or supply chain  

    Familiar with Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel

    Comfortable with working and navigating in digital IT solutions

    Fluent in both written and spoken English

It’s a plus if you also:

    Are service-minded with a clear and respectful way of communicating

    Work in a structured way both on your own, in a team and with relevant stakeholders.  

    Find motivation in routine-based work and a process driven environment with a high pace.  

    We are looking for a proactive and self-motivated individual who takes ownership of their work and continuously seeks opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.

    A broad professional network within customs, logistics, or relevant stakeholder groups is considered an advantage.

Be yourself, a Customs Operations Specialist, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

Customs Operations Europe & Africa in Älmhult, Sweden consists of approx. 35 co-workers, divided into 3 Support teams. Our assignment is to secure a well-functioning import and/or export process for more than 30 countries in the region, on different levels of detail. We give daily support and coordination in customs related topics within legal matters, goods flow and IT-knowledge to secure availability, affordability and ensure compliance.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We are currently looking for six new Customs Operations Specialists to join our team and welcome your application. We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.



At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs. At IKEA we’re all on the same project.

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

jobs.title: BPA-assistenter søkes i Hammerfest - fast stilling 20-80 % og tilkalling
jobs.description:
Litt om meg

Jeg er en mann på 60 år som bor i en moderne, tilrettelagt enebolig i Hammerfest. Tidligere jobbet jeg som ambulansearbeider, men ble skadet på jobb i 2007 og bruker i dag rullestol.

I hverdagen trenger jeg assistenter som kan være mine hender og føtter. Det betyr at du bistår meg med det jeg ikke får gjort selv, slik at dagene fungerer godt og hverdagen flyter. Dette innebærer blant annet hjelp til personlig hygiene, matlaging og måltider, handling og andre ærender, samt praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet. Du vil også bistå meg med øvelser og trening, og være med på turer og kjøring.

For meg er det viktig med forutsigbarhet, samarbeid og en god tone i hverdagen. Du blir en viktig del av teamet mitt, og god opplæring vil bli gitt.


Stillingsstørrelse

Jeg søker nå assistenter til faste stillinger i 20–80 %, samt tilkallingsvikarer som kan jobbe ved behov, f.eks. ved sykdom, ferie og annet fravær.

Stillingsstørrelse kan tilpasses etter behov og tilgjengelighet, og det kan være mulighet for større stilling over tid.

Stillingene inngår i en turnus med dag-, kveld- og helgevakter. Det kan også bli aktuelt å prøve ut lengre vakter i perioder, dersom det er ønskelig og hensiktsmessig.

  • Oppstart etter avtale
  • Søknader behandles fortløpende

Hvem jeg ser etter

Jeg ser etter deg som er til å stole på, og som møter opp til avtalt tid – fordi det er helt avgjørende for at hverdagen min skal fungere godt. Du tar ansvar for oppgavene dine og jobber selvstendig, samtidig som du er fleksibel og kan tilpasse deg ulike situasjoner og behov.

Det er en fordel om du er praktisk anlagt og trives med å få ting gjort, enten det er små oppgaver i hjemmet eller mer varierte gjøremål i løpet av dagen. Du trenger ikke å være perfekt, men du må være løsningsorientert og ha en rolig tilnærming til arbeidet.

Det viktigste for meg er at vi får et godt samarbeid – med en trygg, respektfull og uformell tone i hverdagen. Personlig egnethet vil vektlegges.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Du snakker og forstår norsk godt
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Du kan lage enkel, vanlig mat
  • Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før oppstart

Mye mer enn bare penger

Visste du at med erfaring fra jobben som personlig assistent er du ettertraktet også i andre jobber?

Når du jobber så tett på mennesker som assistenter gjør, får du en helt egen kunnskap om relasjonsbygging. Du får kunnskap og erfaringer som er unik og verdsatt i arbeidslivet! All arbeidserfaring er relevant for BPA assistenter. Vi mener at BPA ikke er en helsetjeneste, våre BPA-assistenter skal bidra til at våre vedtakseiere hver dag får en bedre hverdag!

Hva du får som assistent i BPA Nord:

jobs.title: Commercial Floor Installers
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Floor Form (Ireland) Limited are seeking Commercial Floor Installers to join the team based in Co. Meath. The role involves preparing and installing floors including linoleum, vinyl, carpet, coved skirtings amongst other types. The key responsibilities include: - Meeting with our management team and inspecting sites to determine the most appropriate flooring solutions. - Removing existing flooring and discarding of this material, if applicable. - Clearing the work surface from dust, debris, and obstructions. - Preparing the work surface by applying damp proof membranes, primers, levelling compounds, adhesive, or other appropriate materials. - Laying linoleum sheet flooring, vinyl sheet flooring, vinyl tile flooring, luxury vinyl tiles, coved skirtings, carpet tiles, and other types of flooring. - Ensuring that the flooring materials are well-positioned, secure, and clean. - Completing the installation by applying appropriate finishes. - Following safe procedures. Requirements: - Prior experience as a flooring installer - Catalog of completed flooring installations - Valid driver’s licence. - Good arithmetic skills - Ability to install all types of flooring with minimal supervision - Capable of independent and team work. - Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and troubleshooting abilities - Physically fit and able to lift bulky, heavy equipment and materials. The salary range for this role is €37,543.59 - €40,000 per annum based on a standard 40-hour week.

jobs.title: Directeur / Directrice de structure d'hébergement touristique (H/F)
jobs.description:
La Ligue de l'enseignement - Fédération des Œuvres Laïques de la Moselle (FOL57) recrute un(e) Directeur(rice) pour son centre d'hébergement permanent ouvert toute l'année « Les Jonquilles », situé à Xonrupt-Longemer, au cœur du massif des Vosges. D'une capacité de 250 lits, le centre accueille principalement des classes de découverte, des séjours de vacances pour enfants et jeunes, ainsi que des groupes d'adultes, familles et individuels.
En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
Vous partagez pleinement les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de la laïcité, de l'engagement citoyen et de l'accès aux vacances pour tous en conjuguant vision stratégique, sens du collectif et capacité d'action.
Au sein du centre, le(la) directeur(rice) s'appuie sur une équipe permanente composée notamment de deux directrices adjointes, d'une cheffe de cuisine, d'une seconde de cuisine, d'une animatrice environnement, d'un agent technique et de personnels saisonniers et occasionnels ainsi que les services de la fédération.
Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE
- Superviser l'entretien du patrimoine immobilier et des équipements avec l'agent technique
- Organiser les commissions de sécurité et assurer la tenue des registres réglementaires.
- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des 3 labels : Familles Plus, Ecolabels, Tourisme et Handicap
- Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des programmes de travaux et d'investissement en collaboration étroite avec le siège de la fédération
GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE ET FINANCIERE
- Organiser le suivi des réservations et de l'occupation du centre (rooming)
- Contrôler les caisses et le compte courant du centre, Transmettre les pièces comptables au siège de la fédération où est tenu la comptabilité.
- Superviser l'économat avec la cheffe de cuisine et établir avec les adjointes la gestion du tarifs jour

CONDITIONS DU POSTE
- CDI à temps plein.
- Prise de fonction : 1er septembre 2026.
- Classification cadre selon la Convention Collective ECLAT. Indice 400 avec reprise d'ancienneté selon les dispositions conventionnelles.
- Logement de fonction possible. - Astreintes organisées avec l'équipe du centre.
- Véhicule de service, téléphone de fonction
- Mutuelle, Avantages du CSE,

jobs.title: Welders Wanted at Lomac A/S  / Svejsere søges til Lomac A/S
jobs.description:
In English:

About Lomac A/S
Lomac A/S is a Danish manufacturing company specializing in steel constructions, working within areas such as marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbines. We currently have 50–60 employees, and due to a strong order intake and exciting customer projects, we need more skilled welders for our production.
We already have international employees on our team, so we know what it takes to give new international colleagues a good start — both professionally and socially.

We offer

  • Permanent position in a well-established and solid company
  • Modern machinery and good working conditions
  • Training and hands-on onboarding at the start
  • Free accommodation in a single room during your work periods in Denmark.
  • A working environment with experienced and dedicated colleagues
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development


Job content

  • MIG/MAG welding of steel constructions for marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbine projects, among others
  • Reading technical drawings and working according to work instructions
  • Quality control of your own work
  • Collaborating with other production staff to meet delivery deadlines


We expect that you

  • Are a qualified welder or have documented experience as a welder
  • Hold a valid welding certificate 136/138 H-LO45 D168, or equivalent documented qualification
  • Are reliable, punctual, and take a professional approach to the work
  • Can work independently and as part of a team
  • Are quality-conscious and detail-oriented


Requirements for applicants

  • Are a citizen of an EU/EEA country, or already hold a valid Danish work permit
  • Can communicate in English and/or German
  • Are willing to work in Denmark for set periods at a time (rotation scheme – see Terms of Employment below)


Terms of employment

  • Number of positions: 10–15
  • Start date: As soon as possible
  • Employment type: Permanent position
  • Working model: Rotation scheme – employees work a set period in Denmark, followed by a period at home, before returning to Denmark. The preferred rotation is 4 weeks of work followed by 2 weeks off. Travel to and from Denmark is at the employee’s own expense.
  • Working hours: 6–7 days a week x 10.5 hours – day and night shifts
  • Hourly pay: DKK 180/200 (approximately EUR 24/27) per hour
  • Overtime: We follow the current overtime pay rules of the Confederation of Danish Industry
  • Employee benefits: Housing and work clothing is provided
  • Collective agreement: Employment conditions are based on the applicable Collective agreement with the Confederation of Danish Industry (DI).


Contact person
Jonas Nielsen, Business Coordinator
Lomac A/S
Email: jni@lomac.dk
Phone: +45 42 13 39 02

How to apply
Send your application and CV to jni@lomac.dk As soon as possible.
Please write "Welder – Application" in the subject line.

jobs.title: PhD position in psychology
jobs.description:
UiB - Knowledge that shapes society

UiB shall be among Europe's leading universities, internationally recognized for high quality in research and education. As a societal institution, we shall contribute to sustainable and democratic development and be an attractive and inclusive place to study and work.

Video: https://youtu.be/i4SDcLir6OcPhD position in psychology

We welcome your application for a PhD research fellow position within psychology at the Faculty of Psychology, University of Bergen. The position is for a fixed-term period of 3 years. Expected start date is 1st of January 2027 and the place of work is Bergen, Norway.


About the project/work tasks:

The PhD candidate will work as part of the HELP.d-project (Harmonising Evidence and Linking Interventions to Advance Treatment of Pedophilic Disorder). HELP.d is a Horizon Europe-funded research project that aims to improve the understanding, assessment, treatment, and implementation of interventions for pedophilic disorder. 

Main tasks 

  • Conduct a systematic evidence map of measures used in pedophilic disorder research. 
  • Contribute to the development of a conceptual framework for core clinical constructs.
  • Develop measures or refine existing scales.
  • Conduct psychometric analyses.

In addition, the PhD candidate is expected to be involved in joint work with the larger HELP.d network.


Qualifications and personal qualities:

You must: 

  • hold a master's degree (or equivalent) in psychology, forensic psychology, clinical psychology, health psychology, or a closely related field at the time of application 
  • have good knowledge of quantitative methods
  • work independently and in a structured manner, and demonstrate good collaboration skills 
  • have proficiency in both written and oral English 

It is an advantage if you have: 

  • research experience regarding pedophilia or pedophilic disorder, sexual offending, sexual health, help-seeking, stigma, or related areas (this qualification will be given more weight than the remaining advantages) 
  • research experience in psychometric analysis 
  • research or practical experience in clinical or forensic psychology 
  • prior publications and/or conference presentations 

For admission to the doctoral programme, grade B or above is normally required for the master’s thesis, or the average grade of the qualifying degree. Personal qualities will be emphasized. Ambitions and potential will also be considered in the assessment of candidates


About the PhD position 

About the PhD position: The duration of the PhD position is three (3) years. You cannot hold a PhD within the same academic field as this position, nor can you be employed in a PhD position for more than one fixed-term period at the same institution.

The University of Bergen is subjected to the regulation for export control system. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications. If the university has not received the assessment from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs within 6-12 weeks after applying for an export license, any offer of employment will be rescinded. 

About the PhD programme: As a PhD Candidate, you must participate in an approved educational programme for a PhD degree within a period of 3 years. It is a requirement that you meet the conditions for admission to the PhD programme at the University of Bergen.

You can find more information about the PhD programme at the Faculty of Psychology here.


We can offer:
  • Exciting development opportunities as part of your role in a strong professional environment
  • An annual salary of NOK 593 700 before taxes (position code 1017) according to the state salary scale. The position provides automatic salary progression for up to four years, with an annual increase of 3 %. A higher salary may be considered if you have a specialist education.
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Good welfare benefits

Your application must include:
  • A brief account of your research interests and motivation for applying for the position (max 1 page) 
  • A letter of affirmation from the PhD supervisor (please contact Sara Jahnke, see below for contact details) 
  • The names and contact information for two references. One of these should be the main supervisor for the master's thesis or equivalent thesis. 
  • CV 
  • Transcripts and diplomas (higher education) 
  • If you have foreign education, you must enclose certified translations to English or Scandinavian if the original diploma and grade transcripts are not already in one of these languages. 
  • If you have foreign education, you must also enclose a confirmation from HK-dir that the education is recognized to be in accordance with a Norwegian master’s degree. The review from HK-dir may take some time and the application should be sent to HK-dir as soon as you have decided to apply for the position. If no answer within the application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir that they have received your application. Certain educational degrees from selected countries have an automatic recognition, please check this website: Automatic recognition – a quicker alternative | HK-dir (hkdir.no). If you found your educational degree here, you must download automatic recognition and enclose it to your application. 
  • Any additional relevant documentation 
  • Any publications or academic presentations in your name you want to be included in the evaluation of your application

The application and appendices with certified translations into English or a Scandinavian language must be uploaded at JobbNorge.


General information:

Detailed information about the position can be obtained by contacting: 

Professor Sara Jahnke, sara.jahnke@uib.no, +47 55 58 86 13.

Diversity is a strength that enables us to solve our tasks even better. UiB therefore needs qualified employees regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, worldview, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, and age.

 

The University of Bergen applies the principle of public access to information when recruiting staff for academic positions.

Information about applicants may be made public even if the applicant has asked not to be named on the list of persons who have applied. The applicant must be notified if the request to be omitted is not met.

The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at all times.

We encourage applicants with disabilities, immigrant backgrounds, or gaps in their CV to apply. By indicating such circumstances in your application, you may receive favourable consideration. We ensure that at least one qualified applicant from each of these groups is invited for an interview as part of our commitment to inclusivity and equal opportunity. For further information about the recruitment process, click here.


Life as a PhD candidate at UiB

Marion Claireaux tells about life and work as a PhD candidate at UiB.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrtp6VxMeJ4&index=2&list=PLf8ZIYfAO0qjhROTj6SthDbSScg0lSO6G

jobs.description: ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΘΗΜΕΡΙΝΗ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΙΑ ΤΟΥ ΤΜΗΜΑΤΟΣ ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΕΦΑΡΜΟΓΗ ΔΗΜΙΟΥΡΓΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΤΙΚΩΝ ΔΡΑΣΤΗΡΙΟΤΗΤΩΝ ΦΡΟΝΤΙΔΑ, ΕΠΙΒΛΕΨΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΣΦΑΛΙΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΤΩΝ ΠΑΙΔΙΩΝ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ ΜΕ ΤΗ ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ, ΤΟ ΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΤΙΚΟ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΟ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΥΣ ΓΟΝΕΙΣ ΩΡΑΡΙΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ 08.15 - 17.15, 3 ΜΕΡΕΣ ΤΗΝ ΕΒΔΟΜΑΔΑ, 07.30 - 15.30, 2 ΜΕΡΕΣ ΤΗΝ ΕΒΔΟΜΑΔΑ.   , ΠΤΥΧΙΟ ΝΗΠΙΑΓΩΓΟΥ, ΔΑΣΚΑΛΑΣ, ΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΚΗΣ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΟΥ Η ΨΥΧΟΛΟΓΟΥ Η • ΔΙΠΛΩΜΑ ΒΡΕΦΟΝΗΠΙΟΚΟΜΟΥ • ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΕΣ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΕΣ • ΠΟΛΥ ΚΑΛΕΣ ΔΕΞΙΟΤΗΤΕΣ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΗΣ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). jobs.title: ΒΟΗΘΟΣ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΣΗΣ
jobs.description: ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ, ΣΥΝΑΡΜΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΗ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ ΓΙΑ ΣΚΥΡΟΔΕΤΗΣΕΙΣ. ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ, ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟΥ. ΚΟΠΗ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΣΑΡΜΟΓΗ ΞΥΛΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΚΑΛΟΥΨΗ. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΑΠΟΞΗΛΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΟΜΑΚΡΥΝΣΗ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ ΜΕΤΑ ΤΗΝ ΟΛΟΚΛΗΡΩΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ. ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ, ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΞΗΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟ. ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΑΝΑΤΙΘΕΝΤΑΙ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ ΠΡΟΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΟ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗΣ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ. ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΣΗ ΣΤΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ. ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΟΙΚΟΔΟΜΙΚΕΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΒΟΗΘΟΣ ΣΙΔΕΡΑΣ
jobs.description: ΥΠΟΒΟΗΘΗΣΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΑΡΜΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΩΝ. ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ, ΚΟΠΗ, ΛΕΙΑΝΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΣΥΓΚΟΛΛΗΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΗΣ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΣΤΟΙΧΕΙΩΝ. ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ, ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ. ΧΡΗΣΗ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΥ ΤΕΧΝΙΤΗ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗΣ ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΑΣΤΗΡΙΟΥ Η ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΥΝΑΤΟΤΗΤΑ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ. ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΣΕ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝ. ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΕΣ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΕΣ Η ΣΥΝΑΦΕΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΙΣΙΩΤΗΣ ΑΥΤΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΒΑΡΕΩΣ ΤΥΠΟΥ
jobs.description: ΕΠΙΔΙΟΡΘΩΝΕΙ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΑΝΑΦΕΡΕΙ ΤΟ ΑΜΑΞΩΜΑ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΕΧΟΥΝ ΥΠΟΣΤΕΙ ΠΑΡΑΜΟΡΦΩΣΕΙΣ. ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΕΙ ΕΙΔΙΚΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΓΙΑ ΝΑ ΙΣΙΩΣΕΙ ΛΑΜΑΡΙΝΕΣ, ΝΑ ΔΙΟΡΘΩΣΕΙ ΤΟ ΠΛΑΙΣΙΟ ΚΑΙ ΝΑ ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΕΙ ΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΦΑΝΕΙΑ ΓΙΑ ΒΑΦΗ, ΔΙΑΣΦΑΛΙΖΟΝΤΑΣ ΤΗΝ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΝ ΑΙΣΘΗΤΙΚΗ ΤΟΥ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΟΣ. , ΓΝΩΡΙΖΕΙ ΝΑ ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΕΙ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ ΟΠΩΣ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ, ΑΝΥΨΩΤΙΚΑ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟ ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΤΙΚΟ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟ. ΕΠΑΛΗΘΕΥΕΙ ΟΤΙ ΟΙ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΕΣ ΕΧΟΥΝ ΟΛΟΚΛΗΡΩΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΤΥΧΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΤΙ ΤΑ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΑ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΗ ΓΙΑ ΧΡΗΣΗ.   , EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy

jobs.description: ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ ΑΥΤΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΒΑΡΕΩΝ ΤΥΠΩΝ ΑΣΧΟΛΕΙΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΤΗ ΣΥΝΤΗΡΗΣΗ, ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΗ ΜΕΓΑΛΩΝ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΟΠΩΣ ΦΟΡΤΗΓΑ, ΛΕΩΦΟΡΕΙΑ, ΕΚΣΚΑΦΕΙΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΑ ΒΑΡΕΑ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ.   , ΓΝΩΣΗ ΧΡΗΣΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΟΠΩΣ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ, ΑΝΥΨΩΤΙΚΑ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟ ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΤΙΚΟ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟ ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ ΟΤΙ ΟΙ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΕΣ ΕΧΟΥΝ ΟΛΟΚΛΗΡΩΘΕΙ ΣΩΣΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΤΙ ΤΑ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΑ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΗ ΓΙΑ ΧΡΗΣΗ ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΑΚΡΙΒΩΝ ΑΝΑΦΟΡΩΝ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΔΕΛΤΙΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ , EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy

jobs.description: - ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΥΦΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΝΕΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΜΕΣΩ ΤΗΛΕΦΩΝΟΥ, ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟΥ ΤΑΧΥΔΡΟΜΕΙΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΝΤΗΣΕΩΝ ΟΠΟΥ ΑΠΑΙΤΕΙΤΑΙ.   - ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΟΛΟΓΙΟΥ, ΔΙΕΥΘΕΤΗΣΗ ΡΑΝΤΕΒΟΥ, ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑ ΜΕ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ.   - ΠΑΡΟΧΗ ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΕΙΑΚΗΣ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗΣ, ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΗΛΟΓΡΑΦΙΑΣ, ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗ ΠΡΟΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΟΣ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΕΙΩΝ, ΚΑΘΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΒΑΣΙΚΩΝ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΑΝΘΡΩΠΙΝΟΥ ΔΥΝΑΜΙΚΟΥ (HR).   - ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΛΟΙΠΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΣΧΕΤΙΖΟΝΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΤΗ ΘΕΣΗ. , ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΟ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΟ ΑΤΟΜΟ ΜΕ ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΩΝ, ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ Η/Υ. ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΠΩΛΗΣΕΙΣ Ή ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ.  ΜΕ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΟΔΗΓΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΙΔΙΟΚΤΗΤΟ ΟΧΗΜΑ.  ΓΙΑ FULL-TIME + PART-T , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΑ: ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ ΣΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΛΟΓΗ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ. ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ ΣΤΟ ΤΑΜΕΙΟ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΞΗΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΤΟΥ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ. ΑΝΑΛΗΨΗ ΟΠΟΙΟΝΔΗΠΟΤΕ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΚΑΘΟΡΙΣΤΟΥΝ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ/ΤΗΝ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟ/Η ΤΟΥ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ.  , ΑΠΑΙΤΗΣΕΙΣ: ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΗΣ ΓΛΩΣΣΑΣ. ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΕΣ, ΦΙΛΙΚΗ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ, ΠΡΟΣΟΧΗ ΣΤΗ ΛΕΠΤΟΜΕΡΕΙΑ. ΕΥΓΕΝΕΙΑ, ΠΡΟΘΥΜΙΑ, ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ.  , Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: Η AVON ΕΙΝΑΙ ΜΙΑ ΑΠΟ ΤΙΣ ΜΕΓΑΛΥΤΕΡΕΣ ΠΟΛΥΕΘΝΙΚΕΣ ΕΤΑΙΡΙΕΣ ΚΑΛΛΥΝΤΙΚΩΝ, ΚΑΘΩΣ ΕΠΙΣΗΣ Η ΜΕΓΑΛΥΤΕΡΗ ΕΤΑΙΡΙΑ ΑΠ'ΕΥΘΕΙΑΣ ΠΩΛΗΣΗΣ. ΠΑΝΩ ΑΠΟ 130 ΧΡΟΝΙΑ, ΠΑΡΕΧΕΙ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΗ ΚΑΙ ΦΙΛΙΚΗ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΣΕ ΕΚΑΤΟΜΜΥΡΙΑ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ ΜΕΣΩ ΤΟΥ ΦΗΜΙΣΜΕΝΟΥ ΔΙΚΤΥΟΥ ΑΝΤΙΠΡΟΣΩΠΩΝ ΤΗΣ. ΕΧΟΝΤΑΣ 6 ΕΚΑΤΟΜΜΥΡΙΑ ΑΝΤΙΠΡΟΣΩΠΟΥΣ ΣΕ 160 ΧΩΡΕΣ, ΤΑ ΑΤΟΜΑ ΠΟΥ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΖΟΝΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΤΗΝ AVON ΕΙΝΑΙ ΠΟΛΥ ΠΕΡΙΣΣΟΤΕΡΑ  ΑΠΟ ΟΤΙ ΜΕ ΟΠΟΙΑΔΗΠΟΤΕ ΑΛΛΗ ΕΤΑΙΡΙΑ. ΜΕΣΑ ΣΤΑ ΠΛΑΙΣΙΑ ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗΣ ΤΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ ΜΑΣ, ΖΗΤΟΥΜΕ ΑΤΟΜΑ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΑ ΠΩΛΗΣΕΩΝ ΓΙΑ ΛΕΥΚΩΣΙΑ ΕΝΤΟΣ ΤΗΣ ΕΠΑΡΧΙΑΣ ΔΙΑΜΟΝΗΣ ΤΟΥΣ, ΜΕ ΣΚΟΠΟ ΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΤΕΥΞΗ ΚΑΘΟΡΙΣΜΕΝΩΝ ΣΤΟΧΩΝ ΣΤΙΣ ΠΩΛΗΣΕΙΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΕ ΑΛΛΕΣ ΣΗΜΑΝΤΙΚΕΣ ΠΑΡΑΜΕΤΡΟΥΣ. , ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΗΓΕΤΙΚΕΣ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΕΣ. jobs.title: Sjukepleiar, i inntil 100% fast med bonusordning
jobs.employer: GULEN KOMMUNE SONE BREKKE, DALSØYRA, BYRKNES
jobs.description:
Om stillinga 

Gulen kommune har ledig i inntil 100% fast stilling som sjukepleiar ved Sone Brekke, Byrknes og Dalsøyra (Sone BBD) frå snarast/etter avtale. Denne stillinga er for tida knytt til turnus på Dalsøyra, med ein kombinasjon av kort- og langvakter i vekedagane, samt langvakter kvar 4. helg. Det er lagt opp til fleire "rause" friperiodar i turnusen til denne stillinga, pr. i dag. 

Sone BBD har ansvar for heimetenestene i områda Brekke, Byrknes og Dalsøyra. 

Me tilbyr: 

  • Bonusordning på 100 000kr (i 100% stilling) ved binding i 2 år i denne stillinga. Bonus vert som hovudregel betalt ut på slutten av bindingstida, om ikkje anna vert avtalt
  • Løn over tariff for sjukepleiarar i turnus
  • Ekstra helgekompensasjon ved gjennomført vakt 
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar

Arbeidsoppgåver 
  • Sjukepleiefagleg ansvar og oppgåver
  • Pasientretta oppgåver, som til dømes pleie og oppfølging av brukarane
  • Samarbeid med andre faggrupper, 2. linjeteneste m.fl.
  • Andre oppgåver som måtte kome til

I sone BBD arbeider det både nyutdanna og tilsette med lang erfaring. Det er eit tett og godt samarbeid mellom assistentar, fagarbeidarar og sjukepleiarar/vernepleiarar kvar dag. Samarbeidet er viktig for at tenestene våre skal verte best mogleg for innbyggjarane i Gulen kommune, og noko me har fokus på kontinuerleg


Kvalifikasjonskrav 
  • Autorisasjon som sjukepleiar
  • Gode norskkunnskapar - både munnleg og skriftleg
  • Gyldig politiattest ved tilsetjing 
  • Førarkort klasse B

Personlege eigenskapar 
  • Er fleksibel og kommuniserer/samhandlar godt med brukarar/pårørande og kollegaer
  • Vert motivert av å yte gode tenester til brukarane, og kan vere med å gje dei ein stabil og god kvardag
  • Kan bidra til eit godt arbeidsmiljø og har fokus på kvalitet og faglig utvikling
  • Tar initiativ, er strukturert, fleksibel og har gode samarbeidsevner
  • Å vere personleg eigna kan verte vektlagt ved tilsetjing

Anna 
  • Tenestespråket i Gulen kommune er nynorsk
  • Tilsetjing etter gjeldande lover, føresegner og avtalar 
  • For tilsetjing innan pleie og omsorg, miljøteneste, barnevern, i skule, SFO og i barnehage, vert det stilt krav om politiattest etter aktuell/gjeldande lovheimel før oppstart i stillinga. Det skal berre krevjast politiattest av den som får tilbod om stillinga
  • Vi gjer merksam på at søkjarlister med namn, kjønn, alder og noverande stilling er offentleg informasjon. Dersom søkjarar likevel ber om konfidensiell handsaming, og grunnen for å unnta offentleggjering ikkje vert godkjent, får søkjaren høve til å trekke søknaden sin før offentleggjering

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gulen kommune ligg vakkert til ved innløpet til Sognefjorden. Kommunen består av både fjell- og kystlandskap, med 1500 øyer, holmar og skjær, som innbyr til eit aktivt friluftsliv både på land og ved sjøen.

Kommunen har 2301 innbyggjarar, ledige barnehageplassar, og er eit godt oppvekstmiljø for barn og unge. Sjå Gulen kommune for meir informasjon.

jobs.title: Er du vår nye spesialsykepleier på  lindrende arbeidslag
jobs.description:
Har du interesse for å jobbe med alvorlig syke og døende og er en troverdig og engasjert spesialsykepleier? Da er det deg vi ønsker på laget.

Vi har ledig en fast stilling på 75 % på lindrende arbeidslag. Dette er et spesialisert arbeidslag med fokus på palliasjon til alvorlig syke og døende og deres pårørende. Vi søker deg som har erfaring med å legge til rette for hjemmedød og hjemmetid for pasientgruppen.

Stillingen består av todelt turnus med arbeid hver 3. helg. Vi kan tilby rekrutteringstillegg på 15.000,- over tarifflønn, samt masterlønn dersom du har en relevant sykepleierfaglig mastergrad 

Helsetjenester i hjemmet i Stange kommune er inndelt i fire soner etter geografi med spesialiserte arbeidslag innen demens og lindrende behandling. Tjenesten bemanner også et bofellesskap, arbeidslag for barn, dagsenter, demensteam, og et ambulerende dagaktivitetstilbud. 

Hos oss vil du få muligheten til å bli en del av en dyktig og utviklingsorientert ansattgruppe med et trygt humørfylt arbeidsmiljø.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Planlegge og utøve sykepleie til hjemmeboende voksne og barn, som er alvorlig syke og døende
  • Bidra til god struktur og hensiktsmessig organisering av arbeidet i arbeidslaget
  • Bidra til at alle dokumentasjonskrav sikres systematisk oppfølging
  • Bidra til å implementere endringer og prosedyrer
  • Bruk av velferdsteknologi
  • Veiledning av kollegaer
  • Bidra med internundervisning
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisasjon som sykepleier 
  • Krav om videreutdanning i palliasjon eller kreftsykepleie
  • Det er  ønskelig at du har erfaring fra hjemmesykepleie
  • Det er ønskelig at du har erfaring med barnepalliasjon
  • Du er faglig oppdatert
  • Du må ha gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Krav om gyldig politiattest
  • Førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Faglig trygg og opptatt av kompetanseutvikling
  • Skaper gode og trygge relasjoner til pasienter og pårørende
  • Bidrar til et positivt arbeidsmiljø og godt samarbeid
  • Selvstendig, strukturert og effektiv
  • Løsningsorientert og fleksibel ved uforutsette situasjoner
  • Trives i en variert og til tider hektisk arbeidshverdag
Vi tilbyr
  • Et godt og humørfylt arbeidsmiljø
  • Systematisk veiledning
  • En fremoverlent virksomhet som vektlegger både kompetanse og kvalitet
  • Individuell og relasjonsorientert oppfølging fra nærmeste leder med fokus på mestring
  • Varierte og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Vi kan tilby rekrutteringstillegg på 15.000,- over tarifflønn, samt masterlønn dersom du har en relevant sykepleierfaglig mastergrad 
  • Tjenestebilordning
  • Lønn etter gjeldende lov- og avtaleverk
  • Pensjonsordning gjennom KLP

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stange kommune har over 1500 ansatte, og er den største arbeidsplassen i Stange. Som arbeidstaker hos oss kan du bidra til vekst og utvikling og bli del av et stort fagmiljø med kolleger fra mange ulike yrkesbakgrunner.

Våre verdier er åpenhet, trygghet og mangfold.

Stange er inngangsporten til Innlandet. I en tid hvor urbanisering er et av samfunnets tydeligste trekk, er beliggenheten til Stange kommune veldig sentral – en grønn lunge i et urbaniserende område. Med hyppige togavganger er det mange som pendler fra Oslo og kombinerer det med hjemmekontor. Videre utbygging av jernbanen vil redusere reisetiden og øke antall togavganger ytterligere.


Det handler om  p u s t e r o m  - å gi folk rom til å være tro mot seg selv og nok plass for å strekke seg mot målene sine.

Les mer om Stange kommune på våre hjemmesider og følg oss gjerne på Facebook og LinkedIn.

 

Offentlig søkerliste

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at det etter offentleglova § 25 annet ledd blir utarbeidet en offentlig søkerliste etter søknadsfristens utløp. Dersom du ønsker å bli unntatt fra den offentlige søkerlisten, må du begrunne dette i søknaden. Stange kommune gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om en søker kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren ber om ikke å bli oppført på en offentlig søkerliste.

 

Søknaden sendes elektronisk via Webcruiter, og all dokumentasjon som du ønsker skal hensyntas lastes opp som vedlegg til søknaden.

jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

jobs.description:
Vi søker dyktig sykepleier eller vernepleier til 100% svangerskapsvikariat hos oss i hjemmebaserte tjenester sone 4 i Stange! Stillingen innebærer arbeid på dag og kveld, samt hver 3. helg, og er ledig fra 04.01.27 - 01.01.28 med mulighet for forlengelse.

Hos oss får du muligheten til å jobbe i en tjeneste i stadig utvikling, hvor både faglig utvikling og spennende utfordringer står i sentrum.Helsetjenester i hjemmet i Stange kommune er organisert i geografiske soner og tilbyr et bredt spekter av tjenester, inkludert: ordinær hjemmesykepleie, spesialiserte team innen demens og lindrende behandling, bofellesskap for personer med demens, fengselshelsetjeneste og ambulerende dagaktivitetstilbud. Den ledige stillingene hører til sone 4 som i dag er en geografisk sone for Ottestad med ordinær hjemmesykepleie. Vi har ett godt fagmiljø på sona med erfarne sykepleiere og helsefagarbeidere. 

Vi er en fremtidsrettet tjeneste som tar i bruk ny teknologi og digitale løsninger for å sikre kvalitet og effektivitet i tjenestene våre. Læring, utvikling og pasientsikkerhet er satsningsområder hos oss. Vi har blant annet fagutviklingssykepleier, AKS- sykepleier, ergoterapeut og psykologspesialist.

Hvis du har lyst til å jobbe i et positivt og løsningsorientert miljø, håper vi du vil søke hos oss!


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Planlegge, utøve og evaluere sykepleie til hjemmeboende.
  • Bidra til god struktur og hensiktsmessig organisering av arbeidet.
  • Bidra til at alle dokumentasjonskrav sikres systematisk og at det gis god oppfølging.
  • Bidra til å implementere endringer og prosedyrer.
  • Bruk av velferdsteknologi som for eksempel multidosedispensere, e-lås og trygghetsalarmer.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Du må ha norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier eller vernepleier.
  • Du må ha god fremstillingsevne i norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Du må ha førerkort klasse B.
  • Det er ønskelig med gode IKT-kunnskaper - og evne til å sette deg inn i nye systemer. 
  • Det er ønskelig med erfaring fra hjemmesykepleie.
  • Det er ønskelig med relevant videreutdanning.
  • Du må ha gyldig politiattest.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du liker å jobbe selvstendig og er trygg i dine faglige vurderinger.
  • Du bidrar med godt humør og godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Du har gode fagkunnskaper og tar ansvar for å utvikle egen kompetanse
  • Du samarbeider godt med kolleger, pasienter, pårørende og andre samarbeidspartnere.
  • Du er robust og trives i en aktiv arbeidshverdag. 
  • Du evner å beholde ro og profesjonalitet i stressende situasjoner, og er god på å se løsninger.
Vi tilbyr
  • Et godt og humørfylt arbeidsmiljø
  • Varierte og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.
  • Tjenestebilordning.
  • Lønn etter gjeldende lov- og avtaleverk. Sykepleiere i Stange kommune tilbys i dag 15 000,- rekrutteringstillegg og 5000,- turnustillegg over garantilønn.
  • Pensjonsordning gjennom KLP.
KontaktinformasjonSophie Bergaust, Avdelingsleder, 40436641, inger.sophie.bergaust@stange.kommune.no
ArbeidsstedRomedalsvegen 6
2335 Stange

Referansenr.: 5182753209

Vikariat
Startdato: 04.01.2027
Sluttdato: 01.01.2028

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stange kommune har over 1500 ansatte, og er den største arbeidsplassen i Stange. Som arbeidstaker hos oss kan du bidra til vekst og utvikling og bli del av et stort fagmiljø med kolleger fra mange ulike yrkesbakgrunner.

Våre verdier er åpenhet, trygghet og mangfold.

Stange er inngangsporten til Innlandet. I en tid hvor urbanisering er et av samfunnets tydeligste trekk, er beliggenheten til Stange kommune veldig sentral – en grønn lunge i et urbaniserende område. Med hyppige togavganger er det mange som pendler fra Oslo og kombinerer det med hjemmekontor. Videre utbygging av jernbanen vil redusere reisetiden og øke antall togavganger ytterligere.


Det handler om  p u s t e r o m  - å gi folk rom til å være tro mot seg selv og nok plass for å strekke seg mot målene sine.

Les mer om Stange kommune på våre hjemmesider og følg oss gjerne på Facebook og LinkedIn.

 

Offentlig søkerliste

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at det etter offentleglova § 25 annet ledd blir utarbeidet en offentlig søkerliste etter søknadsfristens utløp. Dersom du ønsker å bli unntatt fra den offentlige søkerlisten, må du begrunne dette i søknaden. Stange kommune gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om en søker kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren ber om ikke å bli oppført på en offentlig søkerliste.

 

Søknaden sendes elektronisk via Webcruiter, og all dokumentasjon som du ønsker skal hensyntas lastes opp som vedlegg til søknaden.

jobs.title: Kundskapsledningsexpert (Borgå)
jobs.description:
**Östra Nylands välfärdsområde söker en KUNSKAPSLEDNINGSEXPERT för en visstidsanställning för tiden 1.10.2026 – 31.12.2027. Arbetet placerar sig i början vid enheten för digitala tjänster inom koncern- och strategitjänsterna, i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik.**

Enheten för digitala tjänster erbjuder ICTtjänster och ansvarar för utvecklingen av digitala tjänster inom hela välfärdsområdet. Du arbetar i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik tillsammans med andra experter inom digitala tjänster och verksamheten.

Vårt team ansvarar för välfärdsområdets kunskapsbaserade ledning, datalagret och rapporteringslösningarna. Datalagret tar emot data från flera olika patient och kunddatasystem samt bl.a. från ekonomi och personaladministrativa system.

Som kunskapsledningsexpert fungerar du som huvudanvändare för datalagret samt för andra teknologier för kunskapsbaserad ledning. Du säkerställer att datalagerlösningen betjänar välfärdsområdets behov, är nationellt kompatibel och leverantörsoberoende. Du deltar i modelleringen av datalagrets data samt i att producera, utveckla och upprätthålla rapportering. Datalagret är ett Azure Databricks-datalager och rapporteringen genomförs med Power BI. Modelleringen görs med SQL- och Pythonspråk.

Datagrunden består av kund- och patientuppgifter, ekonomiförvaltningens uppgifter, personalförvaltningens uppgifter samt andra uppgifter som är väsentliga med tanke på välfärdsområdets verksamhet. Huvuddelen av uppgifterna har modellerats enligt medaljongarkitekturen. Som expert inom kunskapsbaserad ledning förstår du data och hur data kan utnyttjas för att uppnå organisationens mål. Du är med och definierar informationsbehov tillsammans med ledningen och genomför dem via datalagret till rapporterna.

Din centrala uppgift är att utveckla utnyttjandet av datalagerlösningen och produktiviteten tillsammans med vårt team. Datagrunden ska framöver möjliggöra utvecklingen av analytik, maskininlärning och artificiell intelligens samt förbättra produktiviteten och kvaliteten i välfärdsområdets tjänster. Den exakta arbetsbeskrivningen formas enligt den valda personens kompetensområden.

Företagshälsovården handhas av Mehiläinen. Vi erbjuder också möjlighet att arbeta på distans enligt överenskommelse.

**Behörighetskrav:**

- En högskoleexamen som lämpar sig för uppgiften

- Som språkkrav krävs utmärkta muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i det ena inhemska språket och goda muntliga kunskaper i det andra


**Vi förväntar oss dessutom:**

- Arbetserfarenhet av datalagerlösningar och/eller av att utnyttja stora datamängder i arbetet

- God samarbetsförmåga och erfarenhet av självständigt arbete inom kunskapsbaserat ledning, rapportering eller ICTutveckling och underhåll


**Vi uppskattar:**

- arbetserfarenhet och kunskaper av kunskapsbaserade ledningens uppgifter

- förmåga att lära sig snabbt

- kännedom om nationella riktlinjer för kund och patientdata inom social och hälsovården

- kunskaper i Azure Databricks, Power BI, SQL- och Pythonspråk


Anställningsvillkoren följer VÄLKA. Arbetet är dagarbete och veckoarbetstiden är 36 h 15 min. Den uppgiftsrelaterade lönen är 4290,9 euro/mån samt eventuella tillägg. Prövotiden är sex månader. Sökanden måste ge sitt samtycke till att en säkerhetsutredning genomförs.

Skicka in din ansökan senast 4.10.2026 kl. 23:59. Mer information ges av kunskapsledningschef Mervi Makkonen, tfn 040 152 8109 tai mervi.makkonen@itauusimaa.fi

Vid tillsättandet av uppgiften beaktas i första hand de anställda som sagts upp av produktionsmässiga och ekonomiska skäl inom Östra Nylands välfärdsområde, förutsatt att de uppfyller behörighetskraven för uppgiften.

jobs.title: Produktionsledare Getinge Sterilization
jobs.description:
Company description:

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that contribute to quality enhancement and cost efficiency within healthcare and life sciences. We employ more than 10,000 people, and have operations in more than 40 countries. Saving lives is the greatest job in the world. Everything we do, from architectural planning to the equipment, therapies and solutions aim to secure the safest and most reliable care. As a leading medtech company, we focus every talent and resource towards helping our customers save as many lives as possible.

Job description:

På Getinge är vi engagerade i att hjälpa våra kunder att rädda liv och säkerställa utmärkt vård. Vi erbjuder innovativa lösningar för operationsrum, intensivvårdsenheter, steriliseringsavdelningar och för Life Science och institutioner. Ett jobb hos Getinge kommer att ge dig karriärmöjligheter som både inspirerar och utmanar.







Om rollen  



På Getinge Sterilization AB utvecklar och tillverkar vi steriliseringslösningar för Life Science-industrin. Nu söker vi en Produktionsledare till vår för funktionsprovning och orbitalsvets. I rollen ansvarar du för att leda och fördela arbetet för gruppen samt för att kontinuerligt utveckla personal, arbetssätt och metoder för att nå avdelningens uppsatta mål – med kunden i fokus.











Dina arbetsuppgifter








    Leda, fördela och följa upp det dagliga arbetet inom funktionsprovning och orbitalsvets, samt utveckla personal och arbetssätt
    Säkerställa att kontroll av färdig produktenhet och orbitalsvetsning utförs enligt fastställda rutiner, med fokus på säkerhet, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet
    Driva ett förebyggande arbetsmiljöarbete och bidra till att avdelningens kvalitets- och miljömål uppnås
    Driva och följa upp avdelningens nyckeltal inom säkerhet, kvalitet, leverans och produktivitet.
    Initiera och leda förbättringsarbete enligt Lean-principer och Getinges arbetssätt.







Rollen är placerad på plats i våra lokaler i Getinge, där ditt ledarskap och din närvaro i produktionen är centrala för uppdraget. Du rapporterar till Produktionschefen för siten.















Vad du har med dig



I den här rollen ser vi att du har följande med dig:








    Teknisk utbildning på lägst gymnasienivå, alternativt lång erfarenhet inom tillverkande industri
    Minst 5 års erfarenhet av tillverkningsindustri samt erfarnhet av personalledning inom produktionsmiljö
    Allmän kunskap inom arbetsmiljö och arbetsrätt
    Erfarenhet av arbete i kvalitetsstyrd industri, exempelvis medicinteknik, läkemedel, processindustri eller liknande, är meriterande
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift







Förutom dina erfarenheter värderar vi din personlighet högt. Som person är du proaktiv, drivande och tydlig i din kommunikation. Du är strukturerad, tar ansvar för en säker arbetsplats och agerar när kvalitets- eller miljöbrister upptäcks. Du trivs med att leda och utveckla medarbetare och är van att samarbeta med olika intressenter, både internt och externt.



På Getinge omfamnar vi en lärandekultur där vi tar ansvar för vår utveckling och sätter stort värde på kvalitet och samarbete. Framför allt bryr vi oss om varandra för att vi som team och bolag ska kunna fortsatta utveckla världsledande produkter. Vi är Team Players, Forward Thinkers och Game Changers!







Vi erbjuder



Vi erbjuder ett konkurrenskraftigt kompensations- och förmånspaket, inklusive friskvårdsbidrag, familjeförmåner och gemensamma aktiviteter och föreningsliv. Allt detta för att säkerställa att vi stöder ditt välbefinnande och dina mål.



Vi har en öppen dialog mellan ledare och medarbetare, samt mellan teamen. Vi fokuserar på att utveckla människor och tillsammans skapar vi en plan för lärande och kompetensutveckling när du börjar din karriär hos oss.







Ansökan



Ansökningar kommer att granskas löpande och vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-10-10. Vi ber dig att skicka in din ansökan i vårt rekryteringssystem genom att klicka på knappen "ansök nu". På grund av GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via e-post.



Om du har några frågor angående processen vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på   Emma.paulsson@getinge.com.







Vi ser fram emot din ansökan. Vi hoppas att du vill följa med oss på vår resa mot att bli världens mest eftertraktade medicintekniska företag.

- Taking customer orders and handling payments

- Helping customers and explaining our menu and products

- Sales and recommending products to customers

- Serving food and drinks

jobs.title: Distance Technologies: Data Collection Driver
jobs.description:
**Type:** Part-time, fixed term

**Location:** John Stenbergin ranta 2, Helsinki

**Application deadline:** 1.10.2026

Drive, collect real-world data and help develop next-generation technology designed to make vehicles safer and smarter.

**What will you be doing?**

Distance Technologies is looking for a part-time Data Collection Driver to support the development of its next-generation display technologies. Your main responsibility is to drive a Distance-provided car and collect camera and sensor data in different environments around the capital area. The data is used by Distances R&D teams to develop technologies such as depth estimation, positioning, and latency compensation, so your drives might take you from city streets and highways to forest roads in varying conditions.

Based on requests from the engineering team, you will plan suitable routes, operate pre-made data collection scripts from a laptop, and verify that the cameras and sensors are working properly. During the drive, you will troubleshoot basic technical issues independently, such as Wi-Fi, cable, USB device or storage problems. After each drive, you will check and upload the recordings and document the driving conditions and any unexpected events.

**What makes you a great fit?**

This role suits you if you are looking for a flexible part-time role, where you can combine driving with an interest in technology and gain experience in a real R&D environment. The role can fit well alongside technical studies, but relevant skills and curiosity may just as well come from work experience, projects or hobbies.

You are comfortable with computers, enjoy solving practical problems and can work independently based on technical instructions. What matters is a reliable approach to driving, technical curiosity, and willingness to learn.

**We expect you to have:**

- A valid Category B driving license and responsible driving skills

- Recent and regular driving experience in both urban environments and varying road conditions in Finland

- Good computer skills and confidence following technical instructions

- Ability to troubleshoot basic issues with Wi-Fi, USB devices, cables, storage and similar equipment

- Reliable and independent approach to your work

- Good English skills


**We consider as an asset:**

- Familiarity with Linux

- Experience with cameras, lenses, focusing, sensors, or similar equipment

- Basic scripting skills, such as automating a file transfer

- Familiarity with computer vision or related technologies


**We can offer you:**

- Chance to build valuable technical experience in a flexible entry-level role that can fit alongside your studies or other commitments

- Opportunity to join a growing deep tech company developing new technology for global automotive and defense applications

- Environment to improve vehicle safety, seeing how the data you collect contributes directly to its development

- Hands-on experience with advanced cameras, sensors, and test equipment while learning how deep tech products are developed

- Opportunity to work closely with experienced engineers, giving you practical exposure to computer vision and sensor development


**Practicalities:**

This is a part-time (16-32,5h/month) and fixed term position until 31.1.2027. Working hours are flexible and agreed based on data collection needs. As data collection depends on suitable weather conditions, scheduled shifts may occasionally need to be rescheduled at short notice due to weather. The role will be located in Helsinki. Salary in this position is 18,00-22,00 €/hour depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

jobs.title: Gode hjemmetjenester ledes av flinke folk! Er du vår nye avdelingsleder?
jobs.description:
Avdelingsleder hjemmesykepleien

 

Vil du lede et engasjert team som gjør en forskjell for mennesker i eget hjem?

Om oss

Hjemmesykepleien er fordelt i to soner. Vi tilbyr helhetlige og trygge tjenester til innbyggere som har behov for oppfølging og pleie i eget hjem. Vi jobber for å skape en meningsfull hverdag, legger vekt på tverrfaglig samarbeid og har fokus på faglig utvikling og kvalitet i tjenestene våre. Hjemmebaserte tjenester er i utvikling og nå søker vi en engasjert og strukturert avdelingsleder som kan være med å videreutvikle vårt gode arbeidsmiljø og styrke tilbudet til brukerne. Avdelingsleder får kombinere menneskekunnskap med faglig utvikling og strategisk arbeid. Stillingen ligger i virksomhet for hjemmebaserte tjenester og rapporterer til virksomhetsleder.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Personal- og fagansvar for per nå 23 årsverk
  • Medansvar for økonomi
  • Lede og utvikle avdelingens ansatte gjennom tydelig kommunikasjon, oppfølging og veiledning
  • Sikre god kvalitet og forsvarlige tjenester til brukerne
  • Legge til rette for kompetanseutvikling og et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Samarbeide tett med øvrige ledere i hjemmetjenesten og øvrige samarbeidspartnere
  • Bidra til effektiv ressursstyring og utvikling av tjenestetilbudet i tråd med kommunens mål

Krav til stillingen

  • Autorisasjon som sykepleier
  • Erfaring fra hjemmesykepleie eller annen relevant helsetjeneste
  • Ledererfaring fra helse og omsorgtjenester
  • Påbegynt eller fullført lederutdanning
  • God kjennskap til lovverk og forskrifter innen helse- og omsorgssektoren
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter og erfaring med bruk av EPJ og velferdsteknologi
  • Evne til å lede, motivere og skape et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du er strukturert, løsningsorientert og har høy gjennomføringsevne
  • Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner og trives med å jobbe med mennesker
  • Du er fleksibel, engasjert og har et ønske om å bidra til utvikling
  • Du takler høyt tempo og endringer på en god måte
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt

Vi tilbyr

  • En spennende og variert lederstilling med mulighet for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Trivelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • En hjemmesykepleie det satses på – hvor kommunen ser viktigheten av stabil drift og faglig utvikling
  • Spennende og utfordrende samarbeid på tvers av avdelinger og fagområder
  • Mulighet til å bidra i utviklingen av framtidens hjemmetjenester med fokus på velferdsteknologi og kvalitet.
  • Lønn etter kompetanse og gjeldene lov- og avtaleverk
  • I denne stillingen har du rett på en av Norges sikreste pensjonsordninger: offentlig tjenestepensjon. Der de fleste tjenestepensjoner kun utbetales i 10 år, er offentlig tjenestepensjon en utbetaling som varer fra den dagen du slutter å jobbe og livet ut. Pensjonen inkluderer også uføre - og etterlattepensjon hvis noe uventet skulle skje. I Kragerø kommune blir alle ansatte medlem av KLP/SPK med 2 % av lønnen. Vil du vite mer om pensjnsordningen ? https://www.klp.no/pensjon/offentlig-tjenestepensjon-kort-fortalt
  • Tilsetting finner for øvrig sted på de betingelser som gjelder i Kragerø kommune, derav  6. mnd prøvetid.

 

Vi ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold, og at våre ansatte skal gjenspeile befolkningen forøvrig.  Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn.  

Etter søknadsfristens utløp, vil det bli satt opp en offentlig søkerliste inneholdende navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bosteds- eller arbeidskommune for hver søker. Det kan gjøres unntak fra innsyn for opplysninger om en søker dersom vedkommende selv ber om det. Opplysninger om en søker kan bli offentlige selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli ført opp på søkerlisten. Dersom anmodningen ikke blir tatt til følge vil søkeren bli varslet om dette. Vil du vite mer om pensjonsordningen? https://www.klp.no/pensjon/offentlig-tjenestepensjon-kort-fortalt

I Kragerø kommune blir alle ansatte medlem av KLP/SPK med 2 % av lønnen. Tilsetting finner for øvrig sted på de betingelser som gjelder i Kragerø kommune, derav 6. mnd prøvetid.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kragerø er en kjent sommerby som ligger vakkert til ved kysten med et mylder av øyer og skjær – Perlen blant kystbyene. Naturen, skjærgården, kunst og kultur sammen med fargerik småbyidyll legger til rette for gode opplevelser og et berikende friluftsliv til alle årstider. Kragerø kommune har ca. 10500 innbyggere og et variert nærings- og kulturliv. Kommunen har full barnehagedekning, et desentralisert grunnskoletilbud og videregående skole med et variert tilbud. Innenfor en reisetid på en time når du en rekke større byer i regionen og sentrale kommunikasjonsknutepunkter. Aktive innbyggere, lag og foreninger, næringslivet og kommunen arbeider sammen til felles innsats og bidrar til at Kragerø er et godt sted å bo, besøke og drive næring i.

jobs.title: Nattevakt Straand Hotel
