For oss er gjestfrihet mer enn en tradisjon. Det er en arv som har blitt videreført gjennom fem generasjoner. I over 150 år har vi hatt gleden av å ønske gjester velkommen til Vrådal. Straand Hotel byr på historie, unike fasiliteter, tradisjonsrik kokkekunst og en varm atmosfære som setter spor.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Selvstendig og ansvarsfull: Du må trives i eget selskap og kunne ta raske, trygge avgjørelser alene når det oppstår uforutsette situasjoner.

  • Rolig og trygg: Evnen til å beholde roen i stressende situasjoner eller akutte hendelser er helt avgjørende.

  • Pålitelig og punktlig: Siden man ofte jobber alene, er det kritisk at personen møter opp i tide og utfører oppgavene grundig uten direkte oppsyn.

  • Løsningsorientert og årvåken: Du må klare å holde fokus og energinivået oppe gjennom hele natten.

Du må trives med nattarbeid: Du har en døgnrytme og helse som passer til å jobbe natt og du vil jobbe en uke på og en uke av rotasjon.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Å bidra til fornøyde gjester gjennom å opprettholde bedriftenes høye standard på service, veiledning, sikkerhet et godt arbeidsmiljø.

· Planlegge å gjennomføre arbeidet i henhold til arbeidsinstruks.

· Skape trivsel blant gjester og kollegaer.

· Samarbeide med og gi informasjon til andre avdelinger.

· Være gjestens kontaktperson.

· Fungere som problemløser for gjesten og selv være ansvarlig for at de situasjoner som skapes eller oppstår blir fulgt opp og løst.

· Ha kjennskap til ansvar ifølge utleverte branninstruks.

· Selv søke informasjon som er relevant for stillingen.

· Ansvar for eget utført arbeid.

Vi tilbyr

Et inkluderende og sosialt arbeidsmiljø, personalmatordning og sosiale arrangementer. Muligheter for leie av bolig.

Konkurransedyktig lønn, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Straand Hotel er et tradisjonsrikt og historisk hotell som ligger idyllisk til ved innsjøen Nisser i Vrådal i Telemark . Hotellet ble etablert helt tilbake i 1864 og har vært drevet av familien Straand i fem generasjoner, noe som gjør det til fylkets eldste familieeide hotell. I dag er det Katrine og Lars Arne Straand som er vertskap.

jobs.title: Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue søger pædagogmedhjælper/pædagogisk assistent til vores børnehave/vuggestue.
jobs.description:
Er du initiativrig, nysgerrig og drømmer du om at være en del af:

- en medarbejdergruppe, der har fokus på udvikling, og hvor der er plads til grin og forskellighed?

- et hus, hvor der er højt til loftet, skønne omgivelser og en kultur båret af højt fagligt niveau?

 Så er det dig, vi har brug for!

 Vores hus er opdelt i 2 grupper:

Yngstegruppen er vores vuggestue, og den er inddelt i tre grupper: Hoppelopperne, Løbebillerne og Springfrøerne.

Ældstegruppen er vores børnehave, og den er inddelt i Græshopperne, som er de ældste og kommende skolebørn, Mariehøns og Sommerfugle for de 3-4-årige.

Alle børn tilknyttes hver deres gruppe og primære voksne, samtidig med, at vi laver hverdagsaktiviteter på tværs af grupperne, når det giver mening.

 Vi har en ledig stilling i vores børnehave på 30-34 timer.

Vi ser værdien i at bringe de ansattes kompetencer i spil i for alle børn og da vi dagligt både morgen og eftermiddag arbejder på tværs af Yngste og Ældste, skal du være åben for at kunne se dig selv i hele huset.

 Vores pædagogik hviler på et fundament af grundmotorik og sanseintegration, altid bakket op af anerkendelse, nærvær, tilknytning og stjernestunder. Der skal være plads til udfoldelse og tid til fordybelse sammen med børnene og børnene imellem.

Vores naturskønne område med skov i baghaven og Frøbjerg Bavnehøj som nærmeste nabo, lægger op til en aktiv hverdag præget af aktiviteter både ude og inde. Kun fantasien sætter grænser…... også for de voksne.

 Vi lægger stor vægt på fællesskabets betydning for alle børn. Ved at understøtte den enkeltes udvikling, sikrer vi barnets mulighed for at føle sig inkluderet og som en del af en helhed.

Vi prioriterer et tæt forældresamarbejde, hvor vi i fællesskab altid sigter mod at vende vilkår til muligheder.

 Vi drømmer om at: 

·         Du elsker udelivet og ser uderummet som en integreret del af børnelivet.

·         Du har stor interesse for, og gerne erfaring med sanseintegration og børns motoriske udvikling.

·         Du er optaget af LEG og Langsom Pædagogik, og du understøtter naturligt børnenes egne initiativer og fordybelse.

·         Du har fagligheden i fokus og reflekterer gerne over egen og andres praksis.

·         Du kan se dig selv i en personalegruppe, hvor der er plads til livsglæde, humor, selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og gå på mod.

·         Du får øje på fordelene i at være en del af friskolelivet, -det tværfaglige samarbejde og den røde tråd på hele Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue.

Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue rummer tilsammen pt. 185 skoleelever, 47 børn på Ældstegruppen og 33 børn på Yngstegruppen. Stedet drives af en forældrevalgt bestyrelse, bakket op af forældreråd i børnehave/vuggestue.

Vi er ca. 48 medarbejdere fordelt mellem lærere, pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere, studerende, forretningsfører samt praktisk personale. Ledelsen består af Konstitueret Skoleleder og Pædagogisk Leder.

 Hvordan ansøger du?

 Stillingen er til ansættelse pr 1. december 2026.

 Vi ser meget gerne at du prioriterer at komme og besøge os, da det giver os mulighed for at vise dig alt det vi kan tilbyde og samtidig kan du mærke stemningen i huset. Ring til os for at lave en aftale om besøg.

 Ansøgningsfrist er senest d. 5. oktober 2026. Samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende.

 Ansøgning og bilag sendes som en PDF til: ansoegning@fofri.dk Skriv dit navn i emnefeltet. Du kan læse og se meget om os på vores hjemmeside http://www.fofri.dk

 Personlig kontakt til pædagogisk leder: Rikke Skovhøj tlf. 54552155 mail: bhleder@fofri.dk eller konstitueret skoleleder Kim Hedegaard tlf. 25143454 mail: viceleder@fofri.dk

Ansættelse sker i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst ”aftale om løn – og ansættelse for pædagogisk personale i de frie grundskoler”.

 Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os inden d. 30. oktober 2026, er stillingen besat til anden side.

Din ansøgning vil blive opbevaret i 6 mdr. Herefter bliver den slettet.

Customer Service & Workplace Support

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Computer Science
jobs.description:
Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, The Faculty of Engineering and Science, Department of Computer science, Electrical engineering and Mathematical sciences has a vacancy for a PhD research fellow position (3 years).

About the position:

The Department of Computer science, Electrical engineering and Mathematical sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (HVL) has a PhD research fellow position (3 years) in the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action «TUAI - Towards an Understanding of Artificial Intelligence via a transparent, open and explainable perspective». 

The PhD research fellow will be part of the PhD programme in Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing and the HVL Software Engineering Group (https://www.hvl.no/forsking/gruppe/programvareutvikling-software-engineering/). The research programme in Computer Science currently includes around 20 professors and associate professors, 40 PhD and post-doctoral research fellows, and master’s students. The prospective PhD candidates will be associated with the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action Doctoral Network (MSCA DN) “TUAI - Towards an Understanding of Artificial Intelligence via a transparent, open and explainable perspective”. TUAI has partners in Norway, Poland, Germany, Spain and Italy.

Due to project funding and operational requirements, the successful candidate should be able to commence the position no later than January 2027. Workplace is campus Bergen.


About the PhD project/ work tasks:

Artificial intelligence and related technologies, such as smart systems, smart manufacturing, and smart cities, have paved the way for significant opportunities for advancing sustainability and energy efficiency. The project will apply recent technological advancements to optimise smart services and devices, improving their sustainability and energy consumption throughout manufacturing and their use in smart cities or other smart methodologies.

HVL contributes their experience in distributed, dynamic, heterogeneous systems that integrate sensor networks, the IoT and mobile devices, using low-power, proximity-based broadcast communication such as BTLE and UWB to collectively solve tasks. These tasks might involve AI-based techniques that are only available on a subset of the participating devices. Aggregate computing provides a unifying foundation for developing these systems, avoiding a centralised server and obtaining deployment on multiple hardware platforms. Within heterogeneous systems, the challenges are that: (i) resource-constrained devices will want to off-load classification to more powerful nodes nearby; (ii) distributed AI-based classifiers will need to be updated and (iii) trust and resiliency will be established through consensus in each neighbourhood of devices. 

The PhD candidate will develop a functioning platform that integrates AI-based techniques into an existing heterogeneous computing paradigm, and evaluate their solution e.g. on the automated guided vehicles at a partner institution. Their secondary objective will be to develop techniques that ensure trustworthiness and to develop methods and tools to analyse and quantify the various performance parameters of the software on this platform such as degree of privacy, reliability and energy consumption.

Research environment
The computer science research environment at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences has a strong focus on use-inspired and applied research, and on ICT as an enabling technology. The research environment has cooperation with many national and international research groups, and with national and regional industry partners. The research programme includes the research themes of software engineering, engineering computing, sensor networks and measurement technology, grid computing and physics data analysis, machine learning, and interactive and collaborative systems. 

The prospective PhD candidate will work in close cooperation with staff, current PhD candidates and master students in the software engineering research group (https://www.hvl.no/en/research/group/software-engineering/), which has a strong track record in model-based software development and undertakes research on applications in areas such as healthcare, cloud technology and internet-of-things, industrial automation, and robotics.
PhD research fellow receives an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment. The place of employment is Campus Bergen, however, the candidate is expected to spend twelve months in smaller secondments to project partners in Poland, Norway, and Italy, and participate in research schools.


Qualifications:
  • a master's degree in computer science or in a closely related field. Candidates who are in the final stage of completing a master’s degree (but who have not yet been awarded the degree) may also qualify for the position. In this case, a draft of the master thesis and a transcript showing grades of currently completed course work must be submitted with the application. If the candidate is called for an interview, the final version of the thesis and a complete transcript of grades on the master’s degree must be provided at the time of the interview.
  • a solid grasp on object-oriented programming (eg. C++, Java, Kotlin, Swift, …). Programming experience on mobile platforms or embedded systems is an advantage.

  • an interest in the IoT, smart- and self-adaptive systems and their applications. 

    In addition to the required educational background, the following criteria will be evaluated: competence and grades on completed course work, quality of the master's thesis (excellent grade, equivalent of grade B or better on the ECTS grading system), publications (if any), research and teaching experience, practical software engineering skills and experience. Applicants must be proficient in both written and oral English. A possible outline of a research plan for a potential PhD project will also be taken into account. Personal and relational qualities will be emphasized. Ambitions and potential will also count when evaluating the candidates. 

    The candidate must be diligent and display the ability to work independently, supplemented with regular guidance, and is expected to carry out high-quality research and to publish the results in international conferences and journals. Willingness to participate in international networking and travel is expected.

    Candidates already holding a PhD within this field are not eligible for this position. As per MCSA DN rules, the candidate must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Norway for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before their recruitment date. 

    The PhD research fellow must enrol in the PhD programme in Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and must meet the formal admission requirements for admission into the PhD programme. The employment period may be reduced if the successful applicant has held previous employment as a research fellow. 

    The PhD candidate will be assigned one academic supervisor at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences and a co-supervisor. An application for enrolment should first be submitted after an appointment is made, and the supervisor(s) will help with this procedure. The candidate must be enrolled as a PhD student within three months from the start of the employment.


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation should be uploaded as an attachment to the online application:

  • Master Thesis
  • Copies of selected academic publications (no more than 5)
  • Academic transcripts and degree certificates
  • A CV with a complete list of academic publications
  • Diplomas and certificates

Applicants should indicate which publications or parts of publications should be given special consideration in the evaluation. If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. The transcripts must specify the topics, the course works, and the grades at the bachelor`s and master`s degree levels. 

Applicants with a degree from a country other than Norway, need to attach a certified translation of the diploma and transcripts of grades to English or a Scandinavian language, in addition to the original documents, if the original is not in any of these languages. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the  application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

Applicants should note that the evaluation will be based on the documentation submitted electronically via Jobbnorge within the submission deadline. The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. It is of utmost importance that all publications to be considered in the evaluation are uploaded as an attachment with the application, since these are sent electronically to the expert panel. Applications cannot be sent by e-mail or to individuals at the college.

Contacts:

Professor Volker Stolz
phone: +47 55 58 75 86
e-mail: vsto@hvl.no

Professor Marcin Fojcik
phone: +47 57 67 62 73
e-mail: marcin.fojcik@hvl.no

Professor Håvard Helstrup, Coordinator of PhD Program on Computer Science
phone: +47 55 58 75 61 
e-mail: Havard.Helstrup@hvl.no

 


Salary:
  • Good occupational pension, insurance and loan schemes from The Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Exciting academic environment with the possibility of competence enhancement and development
  • Opportunities for training within the working hours 

The Research Fellow position is compensated according to position code 1017 Research Fellow.

There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte)". Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences Bergen has therefore adopted a personnel policy objective to ensure that we achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons of various ethnic backgrounds.

Information about the applicant may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence per.

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications. 


Inclusion, challenging norms, collaboration

Homepage


Om arbeidsgiveren:

With about 17,500 students, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is one of the largest higher education institutions in Norway. A broad range of academic programmes are offered at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels, spread out on five campuses Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund.

Our ambition is to build stronger and more solid academic and research environments that will interact nationally and internationally. The aim is to become a recognized actor on the international higher education arena. Increased international cooperation and engagement in externally funded projects will work towards this goal.
 

The Faculty of Engineering and Science has approximately 370 employees and approximately 3,260 students. The faculty has a broad educational offer at both bachelor's and master's level in engineering and science, as well as PhD education in computer technology. The Mohns Center for Innovation and Regional Development researches innovation and offers master's education in innovation and entrepreneurship. The diving education offers a one-year vocational school education.

The main part of the faculty's activities are in Haugesund, Bergen, Sogndal and Førde, but we also offer decentralized education in Florø, Kristiansund and Stord.
The faculty's activities are internationally based and take place in close collaboration with regional companies, clusters, health trusts and the public sector, including other institutions in the university and college sector. This applies to research, development, innovation and not least education with student projects at all levels.

We are a creative tech company with the ambition to turn a historically expensive and unfair industry into something ethical and sustainable by promoting entrepreneurship.

Our mission to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs is not only reflected in our products but also in our workplace. By fostering a culture of respect, collaboration, and continuous learning, we provide opportunities for personal growth and professional development. Join us in transforming the banking industry and be a part of our journey to empower entrepreneurs.

About the Role

To further develop and scale our tech platform, enabling us to continue improving the banking experience for entrepreneurs, we are expanding our tech department. As a Backend Developer at Froda, you will be part of a cross-functional team working in one of our product areas — either developing features for our partners, improving our credit systems or maintaining our loan and payments core. For each team, the idea is to continuously deliver customer value as well as to improve the technical structure to make sure our systems are stable and healthy. Together with your team, you will design, build, and deliver scalable and maintainable solutions that directly impact our customers.

You will get a unique chance to be a part of a scaling fintech company with strong momentum and a stable foundation, backed by a banking license as a quality stamp.

Who are you?

We believe that you are an experienced and curious developer who thrives in collaborative environments and is passionate about building scalable solutions with real impact. You enjoy working closely with other skilled and open-minded professionals and actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. You are a pragmatic problem solver who communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are fluent in English, Swedish is a plus.

We believe that you have experience of:

    

At least 4 years in a similar role, ideally within product-focused teams

    

Programming in C#/.NET with a solid understanding of modern software design principles

    

Working with SQL and NoSQL databases in production environments

    

Cloud platforms such as Azure (or other major providers)

    

Agile methodologies and best practices in software engineering, including testing, CI/CD, and DevOps mindset

    

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, and microservices architecture is a strong plus

What’s in it for you?

At Froda, you’ll be part of a company that combines the best of both worlds – a fast-moving, high-energy culture with the stability and structure to support long-term success. We’re 100+ ambitious self-starters who genuinely care for each other and the work we do, all while having fun together.

Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop your skills, and shape your own growth journey. With big ambitions and a rapidly evolving business, there’s plenty of room to grow, lead initiatives, and make a real impact on both our company and the industry. If you're looking to be part of a success story and contribute to something bigger, this is the place for you.

Furthermore, you’ll get:

    

An opportunity to be part of an exciting journey, shaping the future of our company and transforming the SME financing landscape

    

Fabulous office overlooking Stockholm and a friendly culture that values work/life balance

    

We prioritize working in the office to maximize the positive impact of in-person collaboration, but we offer flexibility with work hours and remote work

    

Competitive compensation package

    

Insurance and pension plan

This role is all about building the tech that powers funding for thousands of entrepreneurs —if you're excited by our mission, apply or tell a friend!

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
Arctic Skylight Lodge is a hotel opened in 2020, located less than 5 km from the center of Äkäslompolo. The surroundings are unique, as all our buildings are situated in the middle of the forest. We offer 10 glass cabins, a glass-walled restaurant with 22 seats, and a stunning riverside sauna with an outdoor hot tub, featuring views of the river and the possibility for ice swimming throughout the winter.

The restaurant serves breakfast for hotel guests, lunch, and in the evenings a three-course menu. We are looking for a Head Chef to join our team someone with the skills to create delicious and beautifully presented dishes for our guests. We expect flexibility, resilience under pressure, and the ability to lead a small team. We require versatile experience, a self-directed approach to work, and strong problem-solving skills.

We hope you can design dishes that delight our guests and make them want to return. Our menu has traditionally included three starters, four main courses, and three desserts, with flavors ranging from Nordic tastes to Asian influences. There is also a possibility to work morning shifts.

The working language is mainly English. Work begins in November and lasts until the end of the season in April. Salary is negotiable depending on experience. Accommodation is provided and it is located 1,5km away from lodge.

jobs.title: Servitør med A la Carte og bankett erfaring- 80% stilling
jobs.description:
Norefjell Ski & Spa er ikke bare et sted, det er en opplevelse. Beliggende i hjertet av det majestetiske fjellandskapet på Norefjell, er vi stolte av å tilby våre gjester et unikt opphold, enten de er her for å utforske de endeløse skibakkene eller for å slappe av og nyte vår luksuriøse spa-fasiliteter. Vårt mål er å gi gjestene våre en opplevelse de aldri vil glemme og den ultimate opplevelsen av norsk gjestfrihet.

Vi ser at du som søker:

  • Minimum 2 år erfaring fra A la carte restaurant eller bankett servering.
  • Kunskap om mat og drikke
  • Fleksibel og pålitelig, med en lidenskap for å skape gode kundeopplevelser
  • Trives i et hektisk arbeidsmiljø og evne til å mestre stress
  • Du har øye for detaljer og har gode samarbeidsevner som bidrar til en god lagånd på tvers av landegrensene.
  • Du er selvstendig og fleksibel og liker å jobbe i høyt tempo
  • Du har sans for humor og liker å ha det gøy på jobben
  • Du har en varm og omsorgsfull personlighet.
  • Du synes det er morsomt å prate med både store og små, og å gjøre noens dag litt bedre med små midler.
  • Du forstår at salg = service og sammen når vi våre fastsatte mål. Å være i stand til og villig til å utføre oppgavene som er tildelt av din nærmeste leder.
  • Behandle våre gjester og kollegær med respekt.
  • At du behersker både norsk og engelsk flytende.
  • Førerkort og egen bil er en fordel. 

Dine arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Ta nøyaktige kundebestillinger, inkludert eventuelle spesielle ønsker eller diettbegrensninger, og sørge for at de blir formidlet korrekt til kjøkkenpersonalet
  • Servere mat og drikke til bordet i rett tid, sikre at mat og drikke serveres ved riktig temperatur og kontrollere at kunden er fornøyd
  • Yte oppmerksom og vennlig service, svare på spørsmål og henvendelser fra gjestene, og sørge for at de får en positiv matopplevelse
  • Opprettholde god kommunikasjon med nærmeste leder og resten av teamet
  • Hils gjestene med et smil.
  • Presentere menyer og svare på spørsmål om menyelementer.
  • Ta imot mat- og drikkebestillinger nøyaktig. 
  • Håndter kundeklager effektivt.
  • Behandle betalinger
  • Opprettholde renslighet og organisering av bord og serviceområder.
  • Bistå med åpnings  og lukkeoppgaver etter behov.

Hva vi tilbyr:

  • En unik mulighet til å være en del av et av Norges mest anerkjente hoteller - her er det mulighet til å ta neste steg på karrierestigen!
  • Midlertidig ansattelse fra 18. november 2026 t.o.m 31.03.2027
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn og gode personalfordeler
  • Muligheten til å utvikle deg både personlig og profesjonelt i en spennende og utfordrende arbeidsmiljø
  • Ansattbolig i Noresund


På Norefjell Ski & Spa har vi følgende ansattfordeler

  • Tilgang til Bøeseter Bad & Trening
  • 30 % rabatt på mat
  • Inngang velværespa på søndager etter kl 16:00 (gjelder ikke jul, vinter og påskeferie)
  • 50 % rabatt på spabehandlinger
  • 30 % rabatt på spaprodukter.
  • Ansatte med 30% eller høyere stilling får personlig sesongkort fra Norefjell Skisenter.

Hvis du tror at du har det som trengs for å bli servitør hos oss og ønsker å være en del av vårt fantastiske team, send oss din CV og en kortfattet søknad hvor du beskriver hvorfor du er den rette kandidaten for stillingen. 

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Har du spørsmål til stillingen kan du kontakte Restaurantsjef Joanna Malarz, joanna.malarz@norefjellskiogspa.no

jobs.title: Chief Specialist, Physical activity and functional capacity
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about advancing research and innovation that improves physical activity, functional capacity, and human performance across the lifespan? LAB University of Applied Sciences is seeking an internationally recognized researcher with expertise in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields to strengthen its Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group.

We welcome applicants with expertise in areas such as physical activity promotion, prevention of functional decline, neurofunctional health, rehabilitation, digital health solutions, and data-driven assessment and monitoring of human function and performance.

What your work will be like

In this position, you will contribute to the scientific development of LAB's Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and strengthen its national and international profile. You will participate in high-quality research, build multidisciplinary collaborations, and support the development of impactful research, development, and innovation activities.

You will work closely with academic, healthcare, industry, and societal partners in Finland and internationally. You will be expected to actively acquire competitive research funding from Finnish, European, and international funding programmes, publish in leading peer-reviewed journals, and strengthen cooperation between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.

Key research tasks include:

- conducting and leading high-quality research in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields.
- acquiring competitive research funding from national and international funding instruments.
- leading and contributing to multidisciplinary research, development, and innovation projects.
- publishing scientific results in internationally recognized peer-reviewed journals.
- building and maintaining strategic partnerships with industry, healthcare organizations, public-sector actors, and academic institutions.
- strengthening research collaboration between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.
- Depending on the selected candidates experience and expertise, the role may also include leadership of the Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and responsibility for developing its strategic research agenda and scientific activities.

What we expect from you

You have a doctoral degree in a relevant field, such as health sciences, rehabilitation sciences, sport and exercise sciences, physiotherapy, public health, biomedical sciences, human movement sciences, neuroscience, health technology, digital health, or another relevant discipline. Qualifications corresponding to the Finnish title of Docent (Adjunct Professor) are considered an advantage.

To succeed in this role, you should demonstrate:

- a strong track record of internationally recognized research and scientific publications.
- demonstrated success in securing competitive research funding.
- experience in leading multidisciplinary research and development projects.
- experience in collaboration with industry, healthcare, public sector, and academic partners.
- strong communication, networking, and scientific leadership skills.
- The ability to lead and develop a multidisciplinary research team; previous research group leadership experience is considered an advantage.
- excellent English language skills (CEFR C1) and good working knowledge of Finnish (CEFR B2), or a willingness to develop Finnish language proficiency. Additional language skills are considered an asset.

What we offer

The position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the future of physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, and digital health research within a rapidly developing university research environment.

You will join an innovation-driven university of applied sciences with strong regional, national, and international networks. LAB provides access to a growing ecosystem of companies, research institutes, healthcare organizations, and public-sector partners that support collaboration and the development of new solutions. You will work in an increasingly international, highly skilled, and collaborative community that values openness, curiosity, and teamwork. You will also benefit from LAB's developing research infrastructure.

Your primary workplace can be either the Lahti or Lappeenranta campus. LAB follows a modern hybrid work model that combines flexibility with regular collaboration on campus.

The position is permanent and full-time, starting on 1 November 2026 or as agreed. A six-month probationary period applies.

Employment conditions follow the collective agreement for universities of applied sciences (Sivistysala ry). The position falls under the working-time system for experts and support staff, with a regular working time of 36.25 hours per week.

The monthly salary ranges from approximately EUR 5,200 to EUR 6,100 depending on the successful candidates qualifications, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Interested? Please submit your application and CV through the recruitment system by 25 September 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+2). We will review applications on a rolling basis. Only applications submitted through the recruitment system will be considered.

For further information about the position, please contact RDI Director Kati Peltonen (kati.peltonen@lab.fi, +358 44 708 1041). She is available for enquiries on Friday, 18 September 2026, from 13:00 to 14:00 and on Tuesday, 22 September 2026, from 09:00 to 10:00 (Finnish time).

Read more about the LAB University of Applied Sciences [here](https://www.lab.fi/en/info/about-us).

The best of both worlds: studies and work. The LAB University of Applied Sciences is a higher education institution specialising in innovation, business and industry. It operates in Lahti and Lappeenranta, Finland, and also online. We offer education in five fields: health care and social services, technology, business, hospitality, and design, fine arts and visual communication. We focus on supporting responsible, regenerative growth through intangible value creation, multipurpose materials, and human well-being. We have 10 900 students and 650 teachers and RDI experts.

Technical support for using the recruitment system: recruitment@lab.fi

jobs.description:

Position: 5-Axis CNC Machine Setter / Operator Company: N & E Precision Engineering Location: Longford, Ireland Salary: €38 to €42K / annum Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Reporting to: Production Manager About the Role N & E Precision Engineering is seeking an experienced 5-Axis CNC Machine Setter / Operator to join our precision engineering team in Longford. The successful candidate will be responsible for setting up, proving out and operating CNC milling machines to manufacture high-precision components in accordance with engineering drawings, specifications and quality requirements. The role will involve working with 3-, 4-, and 5-axis CNC machining, with previous CNC programming experience being a significant advantage. Key Responsibilities • Set up and operate CNC milling machines, including 3-, 4-, and 5-axis equipment. • Prepare tooling, workholding, offsets and machine settings. • Read and interpret engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T requirements. • Program, edit and prove out CNC programs where required. • Manufacture precision components to the required quality standards. • Carry out first-off and in-process dimensional inspections using appropriate measuring equipment. • Make authorised program and offset adjustments where required. • Maintain accurate setup sheets, tooling lists and production documentation. • Identify and report machine, tooling or quality issues. • Maintain CNC machines and the working area in a clean, safe and organised condition. • Work closely with Production, Quality and Maintenance teams. • Follow all company health and safety and quality procedures. Requirements • Previous experience as a CNC Setter / Operator in a precision engineering or manufacturing environment. • Experience with CNC milling and 4- or 5-axis machining. • Ability to read and understand engineering drawings. • Experience with dimensional inspection and precision measuring equipment. • Good understanding of CNC tooling, offsets and machine setup. • CNC programming experience is a significant advantage. • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety. • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Working Hours The successful candidate may be required to work either: • Day Shift: 8:00 am – 4:30 pm • Evening Shift: 4:30 pm – 1:00 am Shift allocation will depend on operational requirements Career Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced CNC professional to join a precision engineering environment and further develop their 5-axis machining, setup and programming skills. Candidates with previous aerospace or other high-precision manufacturing experience are particularly encouraged to apply. How to apply? Please forward CV to gustavo.cainelli@guspes.com Application Process: We aim to respond to all applicants within 10 working days. If you do not hear from us within this timeframe, please consider your application unsuccessful. We may contact you regarding future opportunities.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Joroisiin
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Joroisen alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

jobs.title: Virksomhetsleder Miljø og samferdsel
jobs.description:
Vil du lede en virksomhet med ansvar for samferdsel, kommunal infrastruktur og offentlige rom?

Ålesund kommune søker en tydelig og utviklingsorientert virksomhetsleder for Miljø og samferdsel. Vi ser etter deg som vil lede en kompleks og viktig virksomhet med ansvar for forvaltning, myndighetsutøvelse, drift og utvikling innen samferdsel, kommunal infrastruktur og offentlige rom.

Virksomheten har ansvar for forvaltning, myndighetsutøvelse, planarbeid, drift, vedlikehold og utvikling innen samferdsel og kommunal infrastruktur. Ansvarsområdet omfatter blant annet kommunale veger, gang- og sykkelveger, parkeringsplasser, broer, kaier, trapper, parker, grøntområder, friområder, byrom, lekeplasser, offentlige toaletter og enkelte idrettsanlegg. Vinter- og sommerdrift er en sentral del av oppgavene. Virksomheten planlegger og gjennomfører også utviklingsprosjekter på kommunal veg og i offentlige rom, og følger opp kommunens ansvar i Bypakke Ålesund.

Som virksomhetsleder får du et helhetlig ansvar for fag, økonomi, personell og utvikling. Du skal videreutvikle en organisasjon med bredt ansvarsområde, sikre god drift og kvalitet, og bidra til samhandling på tvers av fagmiljø og samarbeidspartnere.

Virksomheten har tre avdelinger i dag:

  • Forvaltning
  • Drift
  • Prosjekt

Stillingen inngår i kommunalområde Samfunn, og du blir en del av ledergruppen. Sammen har ledergruppen ansvar for å videreutvikle og profesjonalisere kommunens tjenester.

Kommunens omdømme skapes av dyktige medarbeidere som hver dag bidrar med kompetanse, engasjement og samfunnsansvar på ulike arenaer.

 


Arbeidsoppgaver

Du vil blant annet få ansvar for:

  • å lede og videreutvikle virksomheten i samsvar med kommunens mål og prioriteringer.
  • å sikre forsvarlig drift, forvaltning og myndighetsutøvelse innen virksomhetens ansvarsområder.
  • økonomi, budsjett, rapportering og ressursbruk innenfor vedtatte rammer.
  • å bidra til god gjennomføring av store investerings- og utviklingsprosjekter.
  • å følge opp kommunens ansvar i Bypakke Ålesund og andre samarbeidsprosjekter.
  • å legge til rette for medvirkning, kompetanseutvikling og et godt arbeidsmiljø.
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ønsker at du har:

  • høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå innen tekniske tjenester, samferdsel, ingeniørfag eller andre relevante fagområder.
  • ledererfaring med ansvar for økonomi, personell og fag.
  • erfaring fra kommunal sektor.
  • erfaring med organisasjonsutvikling, endringsarbeid eller komplekse drifts- og forvaltningsmiljø.
  • god forståelse for økonomistyring og offentlig forvaltning.

Det er en fordel med erfaring fra samferdsel, kommunalteknikk, drift av infrastruktur, prosjektgjennomføring eller andre relevante tekniske tjenester.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker deg som:

  • er en tydelig og samlende leder.
  • har god gjennomføringsevne og evne til å prioritere.
  • kombinerer strategisk blikk med operativ forståelse.
  • bygger tillit og skaper gode samarbeidsrelasjoner i organisasjonen, med politikere og med innbyggere og næringsliv.
  • er utviklingsorientert og motiveres av et viktig samfunnsoppdrag.
  • har gode samarbeidsevner, tydelig kommunikasjon og endringskompetanse.
Vi tilbyr
  • en sentral lederstilling med stor samfunnsmessig betydning.
  • ansvar for en virksomhet med høy faglig kompetanse og viktige utviklingsoppgaver.
  • mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen av kommunens samferdselsløsninger, infrastruktur og offentlige rom.
  • samarbeid med sterke fagmiljø og støttefunksjoner innen innkjøp, HR, kommunikasjon, juridiske tjenester og økonomi.
  • lønn etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen mellom Bergen og Trondheim, og et regionsenter for Nordvestlandet. Kommunen har rundt 58.000 innbyggere. Området rundt byr på rike muligheter for et aktivt friluftsliv for alle, jakt og fiske, og kommunen har et rikt og blomstrende kultur- og næringsliv. Ålesund er en universitetsby og har landets største universitet, NTNU.

Kommunen er en stor arbeidsgiver med sine over 4.500 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglige arbeidet vektlegger vi verdiene våre: åpen, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».

jobs.description:
Are you the person colleagues are glad to reach when a system stops cooperating? We're looking for a System Support Technician with Salesforce experience to join our System Support team at our HQ in Lund, or our offices in Linköping or Stockholm - a role where technical problem-solving and genuine service go hand in hand.

Who is your future team?

You'll join our System Support team, ten technicians who maintain and provide first line support for a range of Axis systems, including Salesforce, our own in-house CRM, our intranet, Microsoft 365 and access management. We're part of the internal IT Helpdesk, which supports Axis employees globally.

We're a down-to-earth team where no one is too senior to pick up a ticket. We help each other out without worrying too much about who does what, and we'd rather solve the problem together than protect our own patch.

What you'll do here as System Support Technician

Your day is built around helping colleagues around the world get past whatever is standing in their way. You'll be the first line of support for our own CRM and for Salesforce, and you'll keep access management running smoothly across a range of our systems. Beyond solving what lands in your queue, you'll help make sure fewer problems land there in the first place.

    

Support colleagues globally through our case management system, ServiceNow

    

Handle access management across a range of Axis systems

    

Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the systems we support

    

Create and maintain knowledge articles and workflows

    

Collaboration with other teams on systems that connect to ours



Who are we looking for?

You're service-minded, and you enjoy the moment when a technical problem finally gives way. You're curious about how different systems work and how they connect, and you take a user-centric approach to your work. Sharing what you know comes naturally to you, and you're easy to work with day to day. You know how to prioritize, and you keep your work structured even when several things need attention at once.

You're also an early adopter who is curious about new technical solutions, combined with a pragmatic understanding that not all of them are applicable to our use cases or feasible to implement.

We'd love to hear that you have:

    

Several years of experience providing system support to users

    

Hands-on experience supporting users in Salesforce

    

An IT education, or equivalent experience

    

Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken, since we also provide global support

Bonus points for:

    

Experience working with ServiceNow as a case management system

What Axis has to offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.

We have a host of places where you can learn more about Axis, our products, solutions, company culture, and what working at Axis is really like.

Check out:

Life at Axis blog

Engineering at Axis blog

Innovation at Axis

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

jobs.title: Vi søker servicemedarbeider i helse og omsorg
jobs.description:
Vil du ha en meningsfull jobb der du bidrar til en tjeneste med orden, struktur og god atmosfære for ansatte, beboerne og deres pårørende?

Hva vi ser etter

Du kan gjerne ha erfaring fra renhold, kjøkken, hotell, butikk, lager, logistikk, service, helse eller annet praktisk arbeid. Formell helsefaglig utdanning er ikke nødvendig.

Det viktigste er at du er:

  • rolig, tålmodig og respektfull

  • selvstendig, pålitelig og ansvarsfull

  • praktisk anlagt og glad i orden

  • fleksibel og lærevillig

  • trygg i møte med mennesker

Mange av beboerne har langtkommen demens, og det er derfor viktig at du møter dem med ro, tålmodighet og respekt. Vi ønsker at du har gode norskkunnskaper.

Arbeidstid

Vi har behov for medarbeidere på ulike tidspunkt gjennom uken; på kveld, helg og dagtid året igjennom. Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidsoppgaver avtales ut fra behov og hvordan du best kan bidra i rollen.

Søknad

Fortell oss gjerne i søknaden hva du har erfaring med, hvilke oppgaver du kunne tenke deg og når du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi oppfordrer alle interesserte til å søke. Ikke vær redd for om du ikke treffer alle punktene. Vi er nysgjerrige på hva du kan bidra med.

Før tiltredelse: Godkjent og gyldig politiattest nyere enn 3 måneder. Negativ MRSA og tuberkulose-test. Taushetserklæring fylles ut første dag og gjelder også etter endt arbeidsforhold.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Elverhøy bokollektiv og Sagtomta bokollektiv (langtidsplass i institusjon for personer med demens og personer med skjermingsbehov) søker praktiske- og serviceinnstilte medarbeidere som kan avlaste helsepersonellet med oppgaver som ikke krever helsefaglig utdanning.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Arbeidsoppgavene tilpasses erfaringen din, hva du trives med og behovet på avdelingen. Du trenger derfor ikke kunne eller utføre alle oppgavene:

  • Tilberede og servere måltider, mating

  • Renhold og forefallende kjøkkenoppgaver før og etter måltider

  • Renhold av møblement inne/ute og hjelpemidler

  • Vanne blomster, støvtørking og avfallshåndtering

  • Klargjøring av rom mellom pasienter og mellom vaktskift

  • Orden og forefallende oppgaver på vaskerom

  • Håndtering og rydding av tekstiler/ bekledning

  • Orden og varepåfylling på lager

  • Logistikk: Hente og levere post, blodprøver, annet

  • Bistå kollega med å følge beboere til og fra aktiviteter

  • Bistå å være en trygghet for beboerne i fellesstua

Vi tilbyr

  • En tilpasset rolle basert på din kompetanse

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø

  • Muligheter for fast ansettelse etter prosjektets slutt

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vinn Hallingdal AS er rekrutteringspartner for Nesbyen kommune:

Nesbyen kommune Helse og omsorg

Nesbyen kommune er hjertet i Hallingdal, og ligger mellom Oslo og Bergen i Buskerud fylke. Kommunen har ca. 3 300 innbyggere, hvorav 2 100 innbyggere er bosatt i de sentrumsnære områdene. Det er et stort antall besøkende til kommunen som følge av store hytteområder.

Barnehagedekningen er god, vi har en av Norges beste grunnskoler og det er et variert skoletilbud innen videregående utdanning og fagskoler i Hallingdal. I kommunen er det et mangfold av frivillige organisasjoner for alle aldersgrupper og interesser. Mulighetene for en aktiv fritid er mange både innen idrett, friluftsliv og kultur (www.nesbyen.no). Kommunen er en av Norges mest attraktive sykkeldestinasjoner (www.trailhead.no). Med Bergensbanen og Rv. 7 som fartsårer, er kommunen lett tilgjengelig.

Finn ut mer om Nesbyen ved å se filmen Bo i Nesbyen

https://vimeo.com/528811190

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Developer
jobs.description:
In Purchasing Development, we enable purchasing of sustainable and affordable IKEA products by developing a strong global supplier network. We work close to suppliers, partners, Range and Supply Chain Operations to secure quality, availability, sustainability and the lowest possible cost for the many people.

Within Purchasing Development, Category Area Food is part of the Food total value chain transformation. We are shaping a simpler, more connected and more industry-relevant way of working for IKEA Food, with clearer accountability, faster decisions and stronger supplier performance. Food has its own conditions, with limited shelf life, food safety requirements, freshness needs and changing market expectations. This calls for practical, fact-based and close supplier collaboration.

We are now looking for a Logistics Operations Developer who wants to help strengthen supplier logistics performance and capability across an assigned geography. In this role, you will work close to suppliers and business teams to make sure supplier routines, data quality, logistics compliance and execution readiness support reliable, compliant and cost-conscious supply.

This is a role for someone who enjoys turning operational signals into clear improvement actions. You will help suppliers and office teams understand what needs to be improved, follow up progress and make sure repeated issues are solved in a structured way within agreed ways of working.

About the role

As Logistics Operations Developer, you will own and develop supplier logistics performance for assigned suppliers and geographies. You will follow up delivery performance, data quality, logistics compliance and launch or change readiness. You will also support supplier capability development through analysis, training, implementation follow-up and corrective actions.

You will work closely with Business Developers, Business Development Managers, Product Sourcing Leaders, Inventory Planners, suppliers and other internal stakeholders. Your input will help bring supplier-side logistics reality into business decisions, so we can improve availability, reduce recurring issues and support growth at lower cost.

In this role, you will:

    Own supplier logistics performance follow-up for assigned suppliers and geographies.
    Follow up delivery performance, data quality, logistics compliance and execution readiness.
    Translate Category Business Plan, supplier priorities and improvement needs into practical logistics actions.
    Drive supplier improvement plans and corrective actions that strengthen delivery performance, supplier routines and logistics set-ups.
    Provide supplier-side logistics feasibility, risk and readiness input for sourcing, launch, range change and deviation decisions.
    Train and support suppliers and office teams in agreed logistics requirements and routines.
    Identify process, data or digital improvement needs from supplier operations and secure the right escalation.

We are looking for someone who:

    Has experience from supplier operations, logistics, supply planning, supplier development or operational performance improvement.
    Understands supplier delivery performance, data quality, capacity and readiness, logistics set-up and compliance drivers.
    Can analyse performance data, spot recurring deviations and recommend clear corrective actions.
    Is comfortable guiding suppliers and office teams through requirements, routines and practical improvement work.
    Communicates clearly across cultures, roles and locations, with a simple and fact-based way of working.
    Enjoys solving problems structurally and helping others build capability for long-term performance.

At IKEA, low cost has a meaning. It helps us create better products at lower prices and make them available to more people. In this role, your everyday work with supplier logistics helps turn that idea into action.

You will be part of strengthening the Food value chain by making supplier operations more reliable, more compliant and easier to work with. Together, we keep the customer in the centre, act with business acumen and build a Food setup that can grow with speed, care and cost-consciousness.

We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence

requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

jobs.title: Inventory Planner
jobs.description:
In Supply Chain Operations, we lead, plan and execute the supply of IKEA products between suppliers and retailers.

We work across the IKEA value chain to make sure products reach stores and retail partners in a simple, efficient and responsible way. Our shared goals are clear: availability, affordability and sustainability. Together, we help make IKEA products available for the many people.

Within SCO, Category Area Logistics Services secures and develops the logistics services that make the goods flow work in practice. We work with distribution, mid-receiver units and food logistics services. Together with our logistics service providers, we secure the right capacity, cost, service, quality, safety and sustainability.

Category Food Logistics Services is part of CALS and focuses on securing logistics solutions for IKEA Food, including warehousing, cold-chain transportation and goods flow to stores. We work with temperature-controlled flows and everyday follow-up to support availability, food safety, freshness, cost efficiency and sustainability across markets.

IKEA Food is an important part of the total IKEA experience. It helps us welcome people, bring Swedish food traditions to life, support everyday moments in our stores, and make good food available to the many people. Behind every meal, snack and food product, there is a goods flow that needs to be safe, fresh, reliable and cost-conscious. In Category Food Logistics Services, we commit to make that happen.

About the role  

We are now looking for an Inventory Planner who wants to be part of the IKEA Food goods flow, where planning accuracy supports availability, freshness, food safety and a stronger customer experience. In this role, daily planning and execution come together so food products can move safely, reliably and efficiently from supplier to distribution centre and onwards into the IKEA Food experience.

The role works closely with Category, suppliers, service providers, distribution centres and internal planning teams. You will use signals from orders, stock, forecasts, lead times and distribution to take clear inventory actions, supporting the Food transformation ambition to simplify execution, reduce handovers and focus planning where it creates business value.

In this role you will:

    Own supplier-to-DC and/or DC-DC inbound availability for assigned products, DCs and markets.
    Maintain accurate inventory and inbound flow execution, including orders, ERP corrections and physical-flow corrections.
    Act on daily inventory corrections, inbound order handling, flow bookings and deviations within agreed parameters.
    Balance availability, food safety, freshness, cost, sustainability and lead-time adherence when planning and following up the inbound flow.
    Secure supplier and logistics-service-provider execution through confirmations, holiday planning, inbound coordination and invoice follow-up.
    Manage deviations related to quality, blocked goods, shelf life, shortages and inventory accuracy with timely action and escalation.
    Improve ways of working together with suppliers, service providers, DC/LSP operations and internal stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who:

    Has experience from supply-chain operations, inventory-, supply planning, inbound logistics or DC flow.
    Works confidently in ERP e.g. Infor tools, order-management and planning systems.
    Uses operational KPIs, inventory data and deviation follow-up to make clear decisions, including using excel and Power Bi.
    Understands availability at lowest cost, freshness, quality and inventory-accuracy risks, and knows when to act or escalate.
    Communicates well across suppliers, logistics service providers and internal teams.
    Takes pride in accuracy, structure and keeping the inbound goods flow reliable every day.

Reliable availability depends on many small inventory and inbound flow decisions done right, every day.

As Inventory Planner, you help secure the right products in the right place at the right time, with good freshness, compliance, service and cost-conscious flow. You turn supplier, inventory and distribution signals into action so stores and partners can rely on stable availability, and IKEA Food can be enjoyed with trust, quality and care across markets.

For questions about the role, please contact Business Development Managers Irina Kärnsund via, irina.karnsund@inter.ikea.com or Eda Lennartsson via eda.serdar.jonsson1@inter.ikea.com or Shirley Zhang via shirley.zhang@inter.ikea.com

We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process contact People & Culture Specialists Samuel Karlsson via samuel.karlsson@inter.ikea.com or Femina Ladhani Karlsson via femina.ladhani.karlsson@inter.ikea.com

requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

jobs.title: Business Developer
jobs.description:
In Category Food Logistics Services, we source, procure, optimise, manage and operate cold chain transportation, warehousing and logistics services for IKEA Food. Together with our service providers, we secure the storage, handling and delivery of food products across different temperature needs. We develop solutions that support availability, affordability, quality, food safety and sustainability.

About the role

We are looking for a Business Developer who wants to develop our food logistics business together with service providers and colleagues across the IKEA value chain. You will take end-to-end ownership of sourcing and managing relationships with assigned cold chain logistics service providers. You will turn business needs into practical solutions, strengthen long-term partnerships and improve performance across transportation, warehousing and related logistics services. The role reports to the Business Development Manager.

In this role you will:

    Take overall responsibility for the business and performance of an assigned portfolio of service providers and a defined business scope.
    Turn business needs and market insights into logistics solutions and lead the procurement process from business case and tender through negotiation, agreement and development actions.
    Challenge and support service providers to improve cost, capacity, quality, operational performance, food safety, compliance and sustainability together with relevant IKEA colleagues.
    Use facts, market knowledge and cost understanding to find opportunities, manage risks and recommend solutions that create the best total value for IKEA.
    Secure agreements and follow up that service providers meet relevant requirements for IWAY, supply chain security, financial screening, food safety and operational compliance.

We are looking for someone who:

    Has a university degree in logistics, economics or business administration, or a strong track record from a similar role.
    Understands the food logistics value chain end to end and has experience working with the complexity of global sourcing and logistics. Can balance cost, capacity, performance and sustainability when making business decisions.
    Brings strong negotiation, project management, analytical and financial skills. Can work with cash flow, profit and loss, cost breakdowns and fact-based business cases.
    Has a proven entrepreneurial approach in materializing ideas to solutions together with Service Providers.  
    Communicates clearly in written and spoken English and can present complex business topics in a simple, engaging way.
    Shares our IKEA values, enjoys finding new business opportunities and has the curiosity and drive to turn ideas into practical improvements.

Together, we can build food logistics services that keep IKEA Food available, safe and affordable while preparing our network for tomorrow.

The role works across cultures and time zones and includes regular travels.

With us, you will have room to lead your assignment, learn with colleagues and develop business together with experienced service providers. We trust people to take responsibility, test ideas and learn along the way.

We are currently looking for one Business Developer to join our team and welcome your application. We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence

requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

Bring your business curiosity, logistics experience and partnership mindset, and help us create better food logistics solutions for the many people.

Toiminta kattaa koko arvoketjun malminetsinnästä litiumhydroksidin jalostukseen ja vahvistaa Euroopan akkuarvoketjua. Rikastamo sijaitsee Kaustisen Päivänevalla ja litiumjalostamo Kokkolan suurteollisuusalueella (KIP).
Litiumhydroksidi on keskeinen raaka-aine litiumioniakuissa, jotka mahdollistavat sähköautot, energian varastoinnin ja monet digitaalisen arjen ratkaisut.
Keliber on kansainvälisen kaivos- ja metallinjalostusyhtiön Sibanye-Stillwaterin tytäryhtiö, ja sen toiseksi suurin omistaja on kotimaista akkuarvoketjua kehittävä Finnish Minerals Group.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Etsimme helpperiä avustamaan 16-vuotiasta asiakastamme koulupäivien ajan. Työaika arkisin klo 8-14.30.

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi?
Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii?
Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:
- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."
- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."
- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."

Helpperinä saat:
- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana
- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 12-16 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.
- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Electrical Construction Manager
jobs.employer: Global Taxation Services Nordic Sweden AB
jobs.description:
Role Purpose

To represent the Project Manager on major construction sites and to take responsibility for all site related activities associated with the construction of a varied range of projects. The Electrical Construction Manager will be expected to take the lead on all on-site activities from pre-mobilisation through to commissioning and eventual demobilisation.

Electrical Construction Manager Responsibilities

In conjunction with your project team, you will be responsible for the execution of various stages of a project as follows:

Project Start-Up:

• Assist PM in development of construction programme, short term look ahead planning

reports, equipment and materials schedules.

• Visit site and develop a site establishment schedule.

• Familiarisation with change management with PM.

• Assist in project validation.

• Put site safety starter pack in place and participate in HSEQ plan.

• Set up site establishment.

• Method statement and Risk Assessment preparation and review with sub-contractor.

• Review construction drawings and sign off

• Assist in benchmarking installation practices and Quality procedures

Project Running Phase:

• Productivity

• Develop a daily key action plan that includes HSEQ, productivity and people management.

• Assist Project team in expediting of major equipment deliveries.

• Maintain a site diary

• Attend/Chair internal meetings with sub-contractors.

• Ensure that all variations are picked up in conjunction with PM and QS.

• Ensure labour allocation sheets are being completed by sub-contractors.

• Produce short term programmes in line with master programme.

• Mark up master programme each week and issues to PM.

• Effectively manage sub-contractor supervision to enable efficient productivity

• Ensure sub-contractor workforce is on site at workface on time.

People

• Liaise with sub-contractors to address available work faces.

• Liaise with our client in co-ordination between building and services.

• Work closely with other supervisors to ensure effective co-ordination between M&E services.

• Integrate with other internal and external supervisors to ensure cross co-ordination of trades and installation processes.

• Take ownership and responsibility of issues to drive out solutions in conjunction with Project Manager.

Safety

• Ensure tool box talks, inductions and safety briefings are being carried out.

• Maintain plant logs and ensure weekly safety checks are carried out.

• Ensure operatives are working safely, wearing appropriate PPE and working to agreed method statements.

• Ensure compliance with Health and Safety Policy in particular to the operation of work

permits, site safety audits and weekly walk arounds.

• Carry out daily walk around adopting a “don’t walk by” approach to safety.

• Implement H&S behaviour/culture and Golden Rules.

Quality

• Plan and co-ordinate delivery of materials and plant.

• Mark up drawings in conjunction with inspection testing.

• Ensure inspection test plan is enforced by snagging works, then offering to client for

inspection at various stages of the installation working to ZERO snags.

• Ensure that free issue equipment is checked, cared for and once accepted confirm to engineer to sign off for payment.

Close Out Activities:

• Liaise with commissioning engineer in ensuring all systems are tested, demonstrated and handover.

• Ensure all site safety devices are proved.

• Ensure all life systems are complete and certified.

• Issue final marked up drawings are correct.

• Liaise with PM on site demobilisation, including plant, labour, materials and site establishment.

• Ensure all statutory notices, schematics, wall charts are in place on site in accordance with project completion checklist.

Other Duties:

• Maintain a site diary.

• Assist QS in his / her duties

• Ensure company’s good image is maintained at all times.

• Integrate with site team.

• Ensure your agreed training plan is enforced

jobs.title: KOKKI
jobs.description:
PALKATAAN KOKKI MONIPUOLISIIN TEHTÄVIIN, VAKITUISEEN JA KOKOAIKAISEEN TYÖSUHTEESEEN

Haemme ammattitaidostaan ylpeää kokkia yksityiseen perheyritykseen hotelli Gustavelundiin. Hotellimme sijaitsee Tuusulanjärven rannalla kauniissa puistomaisemissa, noin 15 min Helsinki-Vantaan lentokentältä ja puolen tunnin ajomatkan päässä Helsingin keskustasta.

Asiakaskuntamme koostuu kokouksissa, koulutuksissa ja erilaisissa yritystapahtumissa kokoontuvista ryhmistä, joille valmistamme kokoustarjoiluja, ryhmäillallisia sekä buffetruokailuja. Toteutamme laadukkaasti ja korkeatasoisesti monipuolisia ja vaihtuvia tuotteita: päivittäin tarjolla on hotelliaamiainen sekä lounas, iltaisin tarjoillaan bankettien lisäksi A la Cartea. Viikonloppuisin tarjoilemme brunsseja, olemme myös suosittu perhejuhlien pitopaikka. Terassillamme kesäkeittiössä valmistetaan grilliruokia ryhmille sekä salaatteja, pizzoja ja hampurilaisia walk-in asiakkaille. Hotellissamme järjestetään festivaalityyppisiä tapahtumia, kuten urheiluautotapaamisia, juhannusjuhla, bändi-iltoja ja varttuneemman väen disco-iltoja. Haluamme tarjota vieraillemme mahdollisimman paljon itse tehtyä ruokaa, leivomme ja valmistamme annoksia tuoreista raaka-aineista.

Työkielenämme on suomi. Toivomme sinulta kausivaihteluiden vuoksi joustavuutta: käytössämme on MaRaTes tasausjärjestelmä. Työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti kahdessa vuorossa, arkisin kello 6.00 - 20.30, viikonloppuisin alkaen kello 7.00 ja päättyen aina kulloisenkin tilaisuuden mukaan. Työ sisältää ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Palkkauksen pohjana on MaRaTes sekä normaalit ilta-, sunnuntai- yms. lisät, Kokemuksen määrän ja laadun mukaan palkka on myös neuvoteltavissa.

Arvostamme asiakaspalvelutaitoja, vastuullisuutta ja vieraanvaraisuutta sekä innostunutta ja innostavaa asennetta. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä ammattikoulutus ovat työssä onnistumisen edellytyksiä. Hakijoilta edellytämme aiempaa kokemusta ravintolan keittiössä työskentelystä sekä hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työpaikan, jatkuvan kehityksen ja uudistuksen alla olevat upeat puitteet, mukavat asiakkaat ja huippuluokan työkaverit. Kanssamme olet mukana kehittämässä toimintaa perheyrityksessä, jossa on helppo tuoda esiin omia näkemyksiä ja ideoita ja osallistua toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Työ alkaa heti.
