JOENSUU

Nyt on tarjolla harvoin avoinna oleva ja poikkeuksellisen monipuolinen keittiöesihenkilön tehtävä!

Etsimme innovatiivista, kehittämishaluista ja tiimihenkistä keittiöpäällikköä, joka haluaa ottaa vastuuta ruokatuotteen kehittämisestä ja johtamisesta osana Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan kokonaisuutta Joensuun sydämessä.
Keittiöpäällikkönä vastuullasi on paljon muutakin kuin yhden ravintolan keittiö.

Pääset kehittämään useita erilaisia ruokatuotteita ja ravintolapalveluita:
Mummola-henkistä buffetlounastamme, jossa pääosassa ovat hyvä suomalainen kotiruoka ja tutut maut.
Toreron à la carte -ravintolaa, jonka iltaravintolakonsepti inspiroituu espanjalaisesta ruoka-ja juomakulttuurista.
Juhla- ja tilausravintolatoimintaa sekä erilaisia tapahtumia.
Sokos Hotels Original -aamiaista ja sen ruokatuotetta.

Tehtävässä pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä tuotteemme tulevaisuudessa näyttävät ja maistuvat sekä miten keittiömme toimii. Etsimme ennen kaikkea ihmistä, jolla on näkemystä laadukkaasta ja kannattavasta ruokatuotteesta sekä halua kehittää sitä jatkuvasti yhdessä muiden keittiömestareidemme kanssa.

Et myöskään jää tehtävässä yksin. Saat ympärillesi ammattitaitoisen keittiötiimin, vahvan kollegaverkoston sekä SOK ja Sokos Hotels -ketjun tuen. Pääset kehittämään uniikkia ruokaravintolaa osana Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan monipuolista hotelli- ja ravintolakokonaisuutta.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
Täydet työtunnit 112,5 h / 3 viikkoa.
Harvoin avoinna olevan, vastuullisen ja monipuolisen keittiöesihenkilön tehtävän.
Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa aidosti ruokatuotteeseen ja keittiön toimintatapoihin.
Monipuolisen toimintaympäristön aamiaisesta lounaaseen, à la carteen sekä juhla- ja tilaustarjoiluihin.
Ammattitaitoisen tiimin ja vahvan kollegatuen ympärillesi.
SOK ja Sokos Hotels -ketjun osaamisen ja tuen kehittämistyöhön.
Mahdollisuuden uudistaa, kokeilla ja viedä toimintaa jatkuvasti eteenpäin.

Odotamme sinulta:
Vahvaa kiinnostusta ruokaan ja ruokatuotteen kehittämiseen.
Kehittämismyönteistä, innovatiivista ja käytännönläheistä otetta.
Hyviä tiimityö- ja esihenkilötaitoja.
Kykyä johtaa keittiön päivittäistä toimintaa suunnitelmallisesti.
Ymmärrystä laadukkaasta ja kannattavasta ruokatuotteesta.
Halua tarttua tekemiseen yhdessä tiimin kanssa.
Rohkeutta tuoda esiin uusia ajatuksia ja viedä hyvät ideat myös käytäntöön.

Jos nautit ruoasta, ihmisistä, johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä – ja ajattelet, että asiat voidaan aina tehdä vielä hieman paremmin – tässä voi olla sinulle seuraava askel työurallasi.

Tervetuloa kehittämään kanssamme Toreroa ja Original Sokos Hotel Vaakunan ruokatuotetta Joensuussa!

jobs.title: Project Manager, Industrial projects
jobs.description:
Do you want to lead industrial investment projects that contribute to a safer, more efficient and more sustainable future?
We are looking for experienced Project Managers to join Swecos growing industrial projects organisation.
In this role, you will manage demanding multidisciplinary industrial projects from project development and engineering through implementation, commissioning and handover. Your projects may follow EPCM or similar delivery models and can include a broad range of industrial investments, such as process industry and data centre projects.
At Sweco, you will work closely with clients, contractors, system and equipment suppliers, designers and Swecos multidisciplinary project organisation. You will have the opportunity to take responsibility for impactful projects while being supported by a strong network of experts.
The role may require travel within Finland and, depending on the project, internationally.
What helps you succeed in this role
You have a relevant technical degree (BSc, MSc or equivalent engineering qualification) and at least five years of experience in demanding industrial project delivery. This is not a discipline-specific project management role: you have experience leading broad, multidisciplinary project organisations and coordinating interfaces across engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.
You are able to manage the overall delivery of a complex industrial project, including scope, schedule, budget, risks, reporting and stakeholder collaboration. You can coordinate several technical disciplines and delivery partners, identify and resolve interface issues, and keep the project moving forward towards its objectives.
We expect you to have:
- At least five years of relevant experience in industrial project management or project delivery.
- Demonstrated experience in leading multidisciplinary industrial projects during the implementation phase; experience with EPCM or similar industrial project delivery models is an advantage.
- Understanding of industrial project development, engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning.
- Strong stakeholder-management, communication and collaboration skills.
- Fluent written and spoken English; proficiency in Finnish and/or Swedish is an advantage.

What we offer you
- A curious, courageous and supportive Sweco community. At Sweco, we work together with a low hierarchy and a strong culture of trust. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are ready to share their knowledge, challenge ideas constructively and support you when needed.
- Meaningful and influential projects. You will lead projects that support the renewal of industry and contribute to a more sustainable society. Our work has a concrete impact on the environment where people live, work and move.
- Opportunities to grow and shape your career. We support your professional development through demanding assignments, peer support and the learning opportunities provided by Sweco Academy.
- Flexibility for a balanced everyday life. We believe that work and life should support one another. We combine office-based and remote work flexibly according to the needs of the project and the team. As this is a client- and project-driven leadership role, regular on-site work and travel are expected.
- Comprehensive employee benefits. You can tailor parts of your benefits package to suit your individual needs.

Interested?
Please submit your application via the link provided by Monday, 19 October 2026. We review applications and start initial discussions already during the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For more information about the role, salary or working at Sweco, please contact:
Ville Mykrä
ville.mykra@sweco.fi
Please submit your application through the application form. Due to GDPR requirements, we do not process or store job applications sent by email.

jobs.title: Service Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location: Vantaa, Finland**

At ADB SAFEGATE, we are shaping the future of airport performance. Our solutions help airports operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably — from aircraft approach to gate departure.

To strengthen our service team in Finland, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on **Service Engineer** to support our customers with advanced airport technology solutions.

**Your Mission**

In this role, you will be an important part of our technical team, ensuring that mission-critical airport systems are commissioned, maintained, and supported to the highest standards.

You will:

- Perform servicing, preventive maintenance, commissioning, and diagnostics of ADB SAFEGATE hardware and software systems, both on-site and remotely.

- Maintain and update technical documentation.

- Provide technical expertise and support to our customers.

- Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders while independently taking ownership of assigned tasks.

- Conduct on-site surveys and prepare technical reports.

- Represent ADB SAFEGATE professionally in all customer interactions.


**Your Profile**

On It Films, an in-house video partner for Supercell, is looking for a full-time Gameplay Capture Producer to join their gameplay capture team and help keep the capture process running smoothly from request to final delivery.

**About the role**

As a Gameplay Capture Producer, youll sit at the intersection of gameplay capture, post-production and clients. Youll be responsible for coordinating the schedules and priorities of seven Gameplay Capture Artists and making sure capture requests are understood and prepared correctly.

Youll work closely with the Head of Gameplay Capture, who leads the team and supports you in your work. The environment moves fast, with multiple projects running in parallel and deadlines changing quickly, so keeping production aligned and ensuring the right information reaches the right people at the right time is key.

**What youll do**

- Manage the production schedule for Gameplay Capture Artists based on project priorities, deadlines, artist availability and project needs, while maintaining a sustainable workload.

- Coordinate gameplay capture requests from start to finish, ensuring the team has the necessary information, game builds, instructions and references.

- Act as the communication bridge between Gameplay Capture, Post Production and clients, keeping schedules, requirements, priorities and potential issues aligned.

- Work closely with Post Producers to turn upcoming needs into practical capture plans and identify bottlenecks or conflicts before they impact production.

- Work directly with clients, helping clarify their requests, priorities and delivery expectations.

- Develop workflows, processes, documentation and communication together with the Head of Gameplay Capture.


**What makes you a great fit?**

Youre a strong communicator who works well with people and knows how to keep a busy production moving. Youre comfortable juggling priorities and making sure everyone has what they need to do great work.

Your background could be in game development, gameplay capture, video or post-production, VFX or animation. You dont need to know all of these inside out – what matters is the curiosity to learn the rest.

**You should have**

- Relevant experience across a mix of game development, gameplay capture, video and post-production workflows – we dont expect you to know them all.

- Strong communication skills in English across teams and clients. Whats important is the ability to translate technical or production-related information between different teams, making sure everyone understands not only what is happening, but also why it matters.

- Strong production coordination skills, with the ability to keep multiple projects moving and balance changing priorities, deadlines and team capacity.

- A genuine interest in games and curiosity to learn more about game development and gameplay capture.

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team and help ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of Replit's infrastructure that serves millions of developers worldwide. As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will bridge the gap between development and operations, implementing automation and establishing best practices that enable our platform to scale efficiently while maintaining high availability.



We are seeking Staff SREs who are passionate about building and maintaining resilient systems at scale. Your mission will be to proactively find and analyze reliability problems across our stack, then design and implement software and systems to create step-function improvements. You will design robust observability solutions, lead incident response, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve our infrastructure's reliability, all while mentoring and educating the broader engineering team to make reliability a core value at Replit.




YOU WILL:

 - Architect and Implement Observability: Design, build, and lead the implementation of comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions. Create dashboards and metrics that provide real-time visibility into system health and performance, enabling proactive issue detection.

 - Define and Drive Reliability Standards: Work with product and engineering teams to define, implement, and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs). Build systems to monitor and report on these metrics, holding teams accountable and ensuring we maintain high reliability standards while balancing innovation speed.

 - Lead Incident Management and Response: Act as a senior leader during high-impact incidents, guiding the team to rapid resolution. Conduct thorough, blameless post-mortems and drive the implementation of preventative measures. Develop and refine runbooks and build automation to reduce Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).

 - Drive Automation and Infrastructure as Code: Architect, build, and improve automation to eliminate toil and operational work. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation using tools like Terraform or Pulumi. Create self-healing systems that can automatically respond to common failure scenarios.

 - Optimize Performance on Kubernetes: Collaborate with core infrastructure and product teams to performance-tune and optimize our large-scale cloud deployments, with a deep focus on Kubernetes, Docker, and GCP. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, implement capacity planning strategies, and reduce latency across global regions.

 - Debug and Harden Distributed Systems: Dive deep into debugging extremely difficult technical problems across the stack. Use your findings to design and implement long-term fixes that make our systems and products more robust, operable, and easier to diagnose.

 - Provide Staff-Level Guidance: Review feature and system designs from across the company, acting as a key owner for the reliability, scalability, security, and operational integrity of those designs.

 - Educate and Mentor: Educate, mentor, and hold accountable the broader engineering team to improve the reliability of our systems, making reliability a core value of the Replit engineering culture.

 - Build and Integrate: Write high-quality, well-tested code in Python or Go to meet the needs of your customers, whether it's building new internal tools or integrating with third-party vendors.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 8-10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or similar roles (e.g., DevOps, Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering).

 - Strong programming skills in languages like Python or Go. You write high-quality, well-tested code.

 - Deep understanding of distributed systems. You’ve designed, built, scaled, and maintained production services and know how to compose a service-oriented architecture.

 - Deep experience with container orchestration platforms, specifically Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies.

 - Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining sophisticated monitoring and observability solutions (e.g., metrics, logging, tracing).

 - Strong incident management skills with extensive experience leading incident response for complex systems and demonstrated critical thinking under pressure.

 - Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi) and configuration management tools.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and simply and a bias toward open, transparent cultural practices.

 - Strong interpersonal skills, with experience working with and mentoring engineers from junior to principal levels.

 - A willingness to dive into understanding, debugging, and improving any layer of the stack.

 - You're passionate about making software creation accessible and empowering the next generation of builders.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools.

 - Expert-level knowledge of modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

 - Experience designing and building reliable systems capable of handling high throughput and low latency.

 - Significant experience with Go and Terraform.

 - Familiarity with working in rapid-growth, startup environments.

 - Experience writing company-facing blog posts and training materials.

Your projects may follow EPCM or similar delivery models and can include a broad range of industrial investments, such as process industry and data centre projects.
As a Project Director, you will take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of large and demanding industrial investment projects, or broader project portfolios. You will lead the project at a strategic and commercial level, from early project development through execution, commissioning and handover.
We are looking for senior professionals with strong experience in leading project delivery, building high-performing project organisations and working closely with clients and partners. You have a relevant technical degree (BSc, MSc or equivalent engineering qualification) and 10+ years of experience in senior project leadership roles. jobs.title: Service Engineer- SeaQ Control
jobs.description:
VARD Electro is shaping the future of shipbuilding through advanced electrical, automation and integrated technology solutions. Through our SeaQ portfolio, we support our customers worldwide with reliable, intelligent systems that enhance safety, connectivity, and operational performance at sea.

Our Service Department is expanding, and we are looking for a Service Engineer in the SeaQ Control field to join us! SeaQ Control is VARD Electro's automation platform for monitoring and controlling vessel systems. The solution integrates alarm, monitoring and control functions and plays a key role in the safe and efficient operation of advanced vessels worldwide. You will join a specialized and collaborative environment where different disciplines come together to deliver cutting-edge solutions for the global maritime industry.

At VARD we care about nurturing talents and embracing diverse strengths, giving everyone the opportunity to develop and grow. Join us and be part of a community that celebrates your skills, and where together we are shaping the future of shipbuilding. 


Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will play a key role in the commissioning and service of our SeaQ Control systems delivered to customers worldwide. You will work hands-on with advanced automation and control systems, both on board vessels and in-house, contributing to projects that ensure safe and efficient vessel operations.
Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting and maintenance activities, and providing technical assistance to customers and colleagues. You will also participate in factory testing, reporting, and other in-house support activities.
This position involves extensive travel, and we are looking for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys solving technical challenges, works well independently, and has a strong customer-focused mindset.

Qualifications
  • Technical background/education within Automation (Technician Level/ Bachelor/ Master)
  • Experience from commissioning, service, troubleshooting or maintenance of automation and control systems
  • Strong competence in PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial networks and instrumentation

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong technical understanding and interest 
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Customer-oriented mindset and professional communication skills
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian and English
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team
  • Norwegian driver's license
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • Geographical / rotation flexibility
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with VARD Social you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

Vard Electro is a globally recognized and trusted provider and advisor of marine electrical systems. Established in Norway in 1997, Vard Electro has today approx. 900 employees based in Norway, Romania, Brazil, Singapore, India, Italy, UK, Canada, USA and Vietnam, and operating worldwide.

In close cooperation with the customer, Vard Electro offers ­effective and environmentally friendly solutions with a focus on optimization of the operational performance. jobs.title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Trekantsområdet
jobs.description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

 

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

 

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

 

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

 

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Derfor er det ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

 

Med udgangspunkt fra en eller flere af vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabriksleder Tobias Meier Jørgensen på telefon 2871 4678 eller områdechef Kent Florczak på telefon 29254481.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

 

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

  • En fleksibel arbeidshverdag som passer godt for deg som trives med varierte arbeidstider
  • 30-60 % stilling

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Vi gleder oss til å få flere nye kolleger med på laget, og håper du er en av dem!

Ta gjerne kontakt om du skulle ha noen spørsmål.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, sosiaalihuollon resurssiyksikkö, Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue
jobs.description:
Haemme ammattitaitoisia ja motivoituneita lähihoitajia varahenkilöstöön toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen vammaispalveluun, mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut sekä vanhuspalveluun. Tarvitsemme tiimiimme joustavia ja sopeutuvia ammattilaisia, jotka pystyvät tukemaan yksiköitämme äkillisissä sijaistarpeissa.

Varahenkilönä työskenteleminen on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Se tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistaan ja laajentaa kokemusta eri työympäristöissä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää joustavuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä toimia sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä.

Odotamme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta alalta ja osaamista asiakastyöstä sekä kuntoutuksesta. Erityisesti arvostamme positiivista ja iloista asennetta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Esimiehen täyden tuen ja hyvät työtoverit
- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä monipuolisessa työssä
- Joustavat työajat ja työskentely-ympäristön, joka tukee hyvinvointiasi ja ammatillista kehittymistäsi.

Jos sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, positiivinen asenne ja intoa työskennellä eri ihmisryhmien kanssa, voit olla etsimämme henkilö. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Tervetuloa osaksi tiimiämme!

Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun asetuksen (564/1994) tai valtioneuvoston sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä antaman asetuksen (153/2016) mukainen tutkinto.
Tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito maamme molemmissa kansalliskielissä

jobs.title: Seasonal Worker wanted with forklift certificate – for the pumpkin season 2026
jobs.description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Only applicants with a forklift certificate will be considered for the position.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old.

  • EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

  • Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

  • Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

  • A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

  • Be reliable and arrive on time.

  • Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

  • Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

  • Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

  • Please remember to bring:

  • Sleeping bag

  • Warm clothing

  • Practical work clothes

  • Boots and waterproof clothing

  • Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

  • A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

  • A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

  • Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

  • Tax Information 2026

  • You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

  • If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

  • If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

  • Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@thorsbjerggaard.dk

If you do not hear from us within two weeks, please assume that your application was unsuccessful and that we are unable to offer you a position for 2026.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.description:
Main responsibilities
Lead, support, and develop a team of Network Engineers.
Organize the team’s workload and coordinate operational and project priorities.
Ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of network infrastructure across multiple data centres.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex network incidents.
Coordinate incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
Review network configurations, planned changes, implementation procedures, and rollback plans.
Participate in network architecture, capacity planning, infrastructure expansion, and the deployment of new locations.
Establish technical standards and improve network-management procedures.
Promote the automation of repetitive configuration and operational tasks.
Monitor network performance, recurring incidents, operational risks, and service-quality indicators.
Coordinate maintenance activities with data centres, carriers, equipment vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, configuration standards, and knowledge base materials.
Conduct one-to-one meetings, performance reviews, and technical-development planning.
Support recruitment, onboarding, mentoring, and knowledge sharing within the team.
Prepare operational reports and communicate technical risks and resource requirements to management.

Requirements
At least five years of professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, hosting, or data-centre networking.
Previous experience leading, coordinating, or mentoring network engineers.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network redundancy.
Advanced understanding of BGP and OSPF.
Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.

Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

jobs.title: KYC Officer - CDD 12 months (m/f)
jobs.description:
KYC Officer - CDD 12 months
Customer Operations - Findel, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

About Utmost International
Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

About Utmost Luxembourg S.A.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role - Are you ready for a challenge?

Following an end-to-end Client due diligence review the primary role of the team is to clear any gaps while improving quality and achieving compliance with current and future regulatory standards.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

• Act as the person of contact for partner and client queries received by email, post or by telephone in respect of client data management,
• Take the necessary action to respond in an effective, professional and timely manner to the queries received by telephone, email or post from partners, clients or sales colleagues consistently ensuring a high level of service,
• Perform accurate and timely processing of the receipt of client data and query resolution relating to the management of client data, including document management, review of information and update of our Data Management system,
• Assist in processing the due diligence review of transactions in line with corporate and regulatory standards,
• Assist in contacting Partners and Clients to collect up to date data information and document collected through the KYC process,
• Assist in contacting clients using mass mailing and other client outreaching tool,
• Assist in communicating to Partner and Client on corporate initiatives,
• Develop and maintain a strong working relationship with our sales consultants and all partners,
• Maintain an ongoing awareness of services, review procedures and ensure quality improvements are made as required.

Your profile – Have you got what it takes to become our KYC Officer?

• A minimum of 2 years experience working within the financial/insurance sector,
• Aware of developments within the financial/insurance sector in general,
• Knowledge of Compliance and AML regulation in the Life insurance sector,
• Experience in AML/KYC remediation or with client due diligence,
• You enjoy working in a challenging, fast paced environment and look for the opportunity to excel in all aspects of your role;
• Take personal pride in delivering high quality service to internal and external clients,
• Strong prioritisation skills and flexible, reliable and responsible in challenging situations,
• A team player with excellent interpersonal, customer service and communication skills (verbal and written) with active listening skills,
• Ability to work independently while keen to work as part of a team and assist colleagues,
• Ability to demonstrate a high level of initiative and problem-solving capabilities,
• You will be self-motivated with a high level of attention to detail, ability to understand client requirements and to develop relevant solutions,
• Willing to make the extra effort as required,

Junior Client Relationship Officer - Family Office

BDO in Luxembourg is looking for a Junior Client Relationship Officer!

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries, and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with our expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized service and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 42 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skill development and ownership among our team members. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect, and responsibility define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that nurtures professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

• Perform the day-to-day bookkeeping for a portfolio of Luxembourg companies under LuxGAAP, with the supervision of team members / manager;
• Prepare working files and annual accounts in the firm's digital workflow tools, ensuring files are complete, documented and ready for managerial review;
• Prepare reports for periodic closings and annual financial statements;
• Prepare periodic and annual VAT and direct tax returns, with guidance from specialist teams where needed (trainings can be provided by our specialist teams if needed);
• Ensure the financial follow-up of clients;
• Coordinate client management with other departments (accounting, tax, corporate and legal) to ensure timely completion, review and follow-up of client deliverables.

This offer is for you if:

• Master's degree in accounting or finance, or at minimum a bachelor's degree in accounting.
• You show a strong interest in accounting, accounting digitalisation and data processing.
• Up to 1-2 years of experience, following an internship or demonstrated interest in accounting and tax.
• Fluency in French mandatory and a B2 level in English is required. Italian is an asset. German is an asset.
• You have excellent organisation skills and ability to coordinate multiple tasks simultaneously while meeting deadlines. You have a strong sense of time management to ensure adherence to the defined budget.
• You demonstrate a strong willingness and motivation to learn and show a strong sense of responsibility and engagement.
• You have good written and verbal communication skills to convey ideas, present findings and prepare client presentations.
• You communicate effectively with clients to request the necessary documentation for the completion of the assigned tasks.

What is waiting for you:

• 13th month + performance bonus + pension plan
• Car leasing scheme, mobility budget
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible hours & homeworking
• Parking access
• Canteen on site
• Free access to our fitness room
• Career development opportunities & continuous learning and development through a wide range of trainings on technical and soft skills
• Company mobile phone and laptop
• Access to a range of employee benefits and preferential offers through corporate partnerships with selected providers
• Action Teams eligible to participate (e.g. football) and classes (spinning, yoga, pilates, etc)

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!
--
In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

jobs.title: Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate

Description du poste

Intitulé du poste
Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate
Type de contrat CDI
Temps de travail Temps plein
Référence 2026-1246  

Activités / Missions

Présente au Luxembourg depuis plus de 100 ans, la Banque de Luxembourg est un acteur financier incontournable de la place au service de clients privés, des entreprises luxembourgeoises et de clients professionnels issus des métiers de la gestion d'actifs. Certifiée B Corp depuis 2023, notre Banque s'engage à renforcer l'impact social, sociétal et environnemental de ses activités.

Envie d'accompagner et de financer les grands projets qui transforment le Luxembourg ?

Le pôle Immobilier de notre département Entreprises et Entrepreneurs accompagne les acteurs incontournables du secteur immobilier à Luxembourg en leur offrant des solutions de financement structurées et une expertise conseil de premier plan. Notre force ? Un ancrage local fort et une capacité à intervenir sur tous les métiers de l'immobilier.
Nous intervenons comme un véritable partenaire stratégique dans l'ensemble des activités de nos clients :
La promotion immobilière
L'investissement immobilier
La construction

En tant que Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate, vous gérez de manière autonome un portefeuille de clients professionnels de l'immobilier et les accompagnez dans leurs projets et dans leurs besoins bancaires quotidiens.

• Vous étudiez les demandes de financement d'acteurs professionnels du secteur immobilier : vous analysez la faisabilité économique et financière de projets immobiliers et étudiez les rapports financiers ;
• Vous rédigez et structurez les demandes de crédits, proposez des solutions de financement en ligne avec l'appétit risque de la banque et défendez les dossiers devant les comités compétents ;
• Vous collaborez avec le département Crédit et Juridique afin de réaliser la documentation juridique et contractuelle relative au financement ;
• Vous assurez le suivi des opérations financées, veillez à une utilisation correcte des fonds et anticipez les risques éventuels ;
• Vous contribuez à la réalisation de crédits syndiqués (club deals) avec d'autres banques ;
• Vous développez et entretenez un réseau solide auprès des principaux acteurs de l'écosystème et représentez la banque à l'occasion d'évènements pour participer à son rayonnement ;
• Vous développez de nouvelles relations clients et identifiez des nouvelles opportunités pour atteindre vos objectifs commerciaux ;
• Vous assurez la revue périodique des engagements et vous veillez au respect des exigences de conformité des comptes (KYC, KYT, AML etc.)

Profil

De formation Bac+5 en sciences économiques, commerciales ou financières, vous avez au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans un établissement bancaire au Luxembourg avec une expérience de minimum 5 ans dans le domaine des financements immobiliers ;
• Vous disposez d'excellentes connaissances en matière de crédits, d'analyse bilantaire et financière, et vous maîtrisez les concepts de financement de projets ;
• Vous disposez d'une expérience avérée dans les financements syndiqués ou financements en club deal et êtes familiers avec les contrats LMA ;
• Vous justifiez de connaissances approfondies liées au marché et aux technicités de l'immobilier au Luxembourg et connaissez les principaux acteurs locaux ;
• Vous disposez d'une proactivité et d'une autonomie forte et êtes orientés résultat ;
• Votre aisance relationnelle, votre sens de la négociation couplée à votre orientation client et à votre engagement professionnel font de vous un interlocuteur apprécié, capable d'établir une relation privilégiée avec les clients ;
• Rigoureux·euse, flexible et organisé·e, vous êtes également doté·e d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse et de bonnes aptitudes rédactionnelles ;
• Vous parlez couramment le français et l'anglais, la maîtrise du luxembourgeois et/ou de l'allemand constitue un avantage.

Convaincus que notre diversité fait notre force, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de la Diversité, Lëtzebuerg. Attentifs à l'égalité des chances, nous nous engageons à travers des actions concrètes, notamment en faveur des jeunes talents, des femmes, des collaborateurs seniors…

Vous souhaitez …

• rejoindre des équipes composées de femmes et d'hommes d'horizons multiples, aux parcours et compétences complémentaires ,
• vous développer dans un cadre de travail respectant l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle ;
• évoluer dans un environnement propice à l'épanouissement de tous les talents…

Adressez-nous votre CV accompagné d'une lettre de motivation via notre Espace Candidats.

Pour information, un extrait du casier judiciaire de moins de 2 mois vous sera demandé avant la conclusion de tout contrat de travail.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Legal Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Career Opportunity:

We are currently recruiting a Senior Corporate Legal Officer for our Luxembourg office. The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to Client Services. He/she is in charge of the day-to-day management of assigned companies.


You will have the following responsibilities:

• Administer the legal and corporate requirements of a diverse client portfolio
• Undertake employee mandates and secondment assignments with clients, ensuring effective service delivery and business continuity of their organization
• Prepare, track and complete legal documentation and ensure its proper execution
• Provide prompt and accurate ad hoc legal and compliance information as requested by internal and external teams
• Prepare meeting agendas and board packs and ensure accurate minute taking
• Track and monitor the accuracy of legal documents and corporate governance
• Assist clients in the execution of their legal obligations; follow-up legal and other company records and update legal files
• Maintain the required statutory registers, ensuring the timely filing of returns with the Trade and Companies Register
• Update statutory and other information contained on various databases
• Provide support with acquisition and disposal of assets
• Provide support with the incorporation of new companies and coordinate with third parties and fund teams to ensure timely and correct completion
• Know and apply procedures implemented within the Company
• Review drafted legal documentation (resolutions, minutes, agreements…)

Your skills:

• A background in law with knowledge of Luxembourg
• A minimum of 6 years' experience in a corporate legal role
• Fund Knowledge is an asset
• Strong company secretarial experience
• Ability to develop and manage client relationships
• Fluent in English and French, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to communicate in an international working environment with all levels of staff
• Highly motivated and pro-active with the ability to prioritise workloads to meet tight deadlines
• Strong administrative and organisational skills

What we offer:

At Centralis, we work in a dynamic, human-size, multi-cultural environment. We attach great importance to the personal fulfilment and professional development of our employees. We offer you an interesting and rewarding job, an attractive salary package and a number of benefits, including training support and flexibility.

Should you be interested, please send your application letter, together with your curriculum vitae, in English, by clicking on the "apply here" button below.

jobs.title: MLAĐI/A PROCESNI/A RADNIK/CA
jobs.description:
Organizacijska jedinica: Proizvodnja, Postrojenje za proizvodnju AN/KAN 2 Opis poslova:
  • Sudjelovanje u primopredaji smjene s procesnim radnikom iz prethodne smjene
  • Obilazak postrojenja, očitavanje procesnih parametara, unošenje podataka u radne liste
  • Sudjelovanje u praćenju procesa proizvodnje na upravljačkoj ploči sukladno uputama za rad
  • Upisivanje rezultata dnevnih analiza javljenih iz Kontrole kvalitete
  • Informiranje smjenovođe o uočenim poremećajima i kvarovima u procesu proizvodnje
  • Poduzimanje korektivnih aktivnosti u cilju normalizacije procesa u suradnji sa smjenovođom i iskusnijim procesnim radnikom
  • Sudjelovanje pod stručnim nadzorom u rukovanju opremom na radnom mjestu u startu, normalnom radu i zaustavljanju postrojenja
  • Sudjelovanje pod stručnim nadzorom u preventivnom pregledu opreme, vizualna zapažanja
  • Uzimanje uzoraka pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Provođenje mjera integriranih sustava upravljanja Društva
  • Primjena pravila ZNR i ZOP
  • Održavanje čistoće na svom radnom mjestu
  • Određivanje pH taline amonijevog nitrata, određivanje koncentracije amonijevog nitrata i uzimanje uzoraka u trećoj smjeni pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Održavanje prohodnosti slivnih limova ispod transportera granulacijskog tornja i održavanje čistoće svih odvodnih kanala u postrojenju
  • Održavanje čistoće (prikupljanje rasutog proizvoda) svih transportera i ostalih uređaja u postrojenju
  • Pranje fluidizacijskog hladnjaka, čišćenje i pranje sita i drobilice, čišćenje i pranje sustava za povratnu frakciju
  • Uključivanje sustava za aminizaciju proizvoda pod stručnim nadzorom (čišćenje dizni, prepumpavanje amina)
  • Rukovanje kompresorom pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Sudjelovanje u obavljanju održavalačkih radova za vrijeme remonta i zastoja postrojenja te obavljanje manjih održavalačkih radova za vrijeme normalnog rada postrojenja te sudjelovanje u poslovima preventivnog održavanja po potrebi
  • Ostali poslovi po nalogu neposrednog rukovoditelja, sukladno potrebama posla, osposobljenosti i osobnim radnim mogućnostima
Uvjet:
  • SSS – strojarski, elektrotehnički ili kemijsko tehnološki smjer
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo u struci.
Traženi profil kandidata:
  • izražene organizacijske vještine
  • spremnost na timski rad
  • odgovornost i pouzdanost.
Nudimo Vam:
  • ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad 6 mjeseci
  • naknadu troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla
  • naknadu za prehranu
  • prigodne nagrade (uskrsnica, regres, božićnicu) sukladno odrebama Kolektivnog ugovora I odlukama Uprave
  • uslugu prehrane u restoranu unutar tvorničkog kruga
  • priliku za rad na raznovrsnim i zanimljivim radnim zadacima u dinamičnom poslovnom okruženju
  • mogućnosti za učenje na radnom mjestu i izvan njega.
Ako ste u navedenom radnom mjestu prepoznali izazov za svoju karijeru i udovoljavate navedenim uvjetima, prijavite se na email adresu: karijera@petrokemija.hr najkasnije do 27.9.2026. godine. jobs.title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

SEGUIMIENTO DEL ESTADO DE TRAMITACIÓN DE AYUDAS Y SUBVENCIONES ACTIVAS: PLAZOS, DOCUMENTACIÓN PENDIENTE Y REQUERIMIENTOS DE LOS ORGANISMOS COMPETENTES, CONTROL Y SEGUIMIENTO DE LA EJECUCIÓN DE OBRAS: ACTUALIZACIÓN DEL ESTADO DE CADA PROYECTO Y REPORTE A LA DIRECTORA DE OBRAS, GESTIÓN DE LA CARTERA DE SEGUROS DE LA EMPRESA: SEGUIMIENTO DE VENCIMIENTOS, RENOVACIONES, COMUNICACIÓN DE SINIESTROS Y COORDINACIÓN CON LAS ASEGURADORAS, BÚSQUEDA Y ANÁLISIS DE NUEVAS CONVOCATORIAS DE AYUDAS Y SUBVENCIONES APLICABLES A LA ACTIVIDAD DE LA EMPRESA (MEDIOAMBIENTALES, AGRARIAS, ENERGÉTICAS, DANA, ETC.), PREPARACIÓN Y PRESENTACIÓN DE SOLICITUDES DE SUBVENCIONES: RECOPILACIÓN DE DOCUMENTACIÓN, REDACCIÓN DE MEMORIAS Y SEGUIMIENTO HASTA SU RESOLUCIÓN, TRAMITACIÓN DE LA AUTORIZACIÓN AMBIENTAL INTEGRADA Y OTRAS LICENCIAS O AUTORIZACIONES ADMINISTRATIVAS NECESARIAS PARA LOS PROYECTOS DE OBRA, TRAMITACIÓN DE AYUDAS ESPECÍFICAS DERIVADAS DE LA DANA U OTRAS CATÁSTROFES O SITUACIONES DE EMERGENCIA QUE AFECTEN A LAS INSTALACIONES.

jobs.description:
Sabiedrība ar ierobežotu atbildību "Mesh Energopārvaldība"

                               Meklē darbā Santehniķis/-e


Mesh Energopārvaldība SIA aicina komandai pievienoties santehniķi, kura galvenais uzdevums būs nodrošināt ēku ūdensapgādes, kanalizācijas, apkures un citu santehnisko sistēmu drošu un nepārtrauktu darbību.


Darbs galvenokārt saistīts ar sabiedrisko ēku – skolu, pirmsskolas izglītības iestāžu un citu pašvaldību ēku – santehnisko sistēmu apkalpošanu, remontu un tehniskā stāvokļa uzturēšanu.


Meklējam praktisku un tehniski domājošu cilvēku, kurš pārzina santehniskās sistēmas, prot patstāvīgi konstatēt bojājumus un veikt nepieciešamos apkopes un remonta darbus.



Tavi galvenie pienākumi:

- Ūdensapgādes un apkures sistēmu tehniskā apkope un remonts.

- Cauruļvadu, savienojumu, ventiļu, krānu, vārstu un citas       santehniskās armatūras pārbaude, remonts un nomaiņa.

- Santehnikas iekārtu uzstādīšana, nomaiņa un remonts.

- Ūdens noplūžu, aizsprostojumu un citu santehnisko bojājumu diagnostika un novēršana.

- Apkures sistēmu apkalpošana, tostarp sistēmu uzpilde, atgaisošana un nepieciešamo remonta darbu veikšana.

- Radiatoru, cauruļvadu, noslēgarmatūras un citu apkures sistēmas elementu pārbaude, remonts un nomaiņa.

- Kanalizācijas sistēmu darbības pārbaude, tīrīšana un bojājumu novēršana.

- Cauruļvadu un santehnisko sistēmu tehniskā stāvokļa novērtēšana.

- Nelielu avārijas un remonta darbu veikšana uzņēmuma apkalpotajos objektos.

- Nepieciešamo materiālu un rezerves daļu noteikšana remontdarbu veikšanai.

- Veikto darbu dokumentēšana atbilstoši uzņēmumā noteiktajai kārtībai.
